common: Art style: 1990s retro Japanese anime cel look. Slightly grainy film texture, flat cel colors with hard-edged shadows, thicker hand-drawn outlines, a muted nostalgic color palette, hand-painted background with soft VHS-era haze, classic OVA fantasy-adventure aesthetic. Historically considerate costumes and architecture (no medieval European armor, no modern objects). One clear focal point, keep the key subject inside the central area of the frame.
avoid: Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, signature, borders, card frames, UI elements, photorealism, gore, nudity.

daniel.setting: Setting: ancient Mesopotamia, Babylon and Persia in the 6th century BC (glazed blue-and-gold brick like the Ishtar Gate, mud-brick ziggurats, palm trees, lapis blue, gold, terracotta and cedar-wood tones).

scenes.daniel: Daniel, a young Hebrew man (late 20s, dark curly hair, short beard, kind and resolute face) wearing a cream linen tunic and a deep-blue shawl, kneeling in prayer at an open upstairs window with latticed wooden shutters in a Babylonian house, facing west toward Jerusalem at golden-hour sunset. Warm golden light falls on his face and folded hands; a scroll rests on the windowsill. Outside the window: Babylon rooftops, a distant ziggurat and palm trees. Mood: peaceful, devout, courageous.
scenes.shadrach: Shadrach (Hananiah), a young Hebrew official in a scarlet-and-cream Babylonian court robe, standing straight and calm on the plain of Dura while a huge crowd of officials and musicians (seen from behind, in the foreground) bows down to a colossal 60-cubit golden statue gleaming in the background under a bright sky. He is the only one still upright, quiet courage on his face. Dramatic, golden atmosphere.
scenes.meshach: Meshach (Mishael), a young Hebrew official in an emerald-green Babylonian court robe, standing calmly in front of the huge glowing mouth of a brick furnace heated seven times hotter, flames roaring behind him, soldiers shielding their faces and stumbling back from the heat, orange firelight lighting his steady, fearless face. Smoke and sparks, intense yet hopeful mood.
scenes.abednego: Abednego (Azariah), a young Hebrew official in a royal-purple Babylonian court robe, stepping calmly out of the open furnace doorway completely unharmed, not a hair singed, wisps of smoke around him; astonished Babylonian officials, governors and King Nebuchadnezzar (in the background, wearing a tall crown) are staring and touching his unburnt robe in wonder. Warm glowing atmosphere, relief and awe.
scenes.nebuchadnezzar: King Nebuchadnezzar II of Babylon, a mighty bearded man in a tall ornate crown and a fringed royal robe of blue and gold, standing proudly on the roof terrace of his palace at dusk, surveying the vast city of Babylon below with its tiered hanging-garden terraces, the glazed blue Ishtar Gate and the Euphrates river. Proud, commanding expression; dark storm clouds with a hint of golden light begin to gather in the sky above him.
scenes.belshazzar: King Belshazzar of Babylon in a lavish banquet hall full of nobles and ladies, holding up a golden temple goblet, frozen in terror: his face pale, knees trembling, wine spilling. On the plaster wall behind him near a lampstand, a ghostly glowing hand is writing mysterious glowing abstract strokes (NOT readable letters). Golden and silver vessels on tables, torch light, guests recoiling in shock. Dramatic, eerie and golden mood.
scenes.darius: Darius the Mede, an elderly dignified king with a white-gray beard in a Median royal robe and a tall tiara, hurrying at dawn to the stone-sealed mouth of the lions' den with a torch and anxious, hopeful eyes, attendants behind him, the first rosy light of morning over the palace walls. Emotional, tense, tender mood.
scenes.cyrus: Cyrus the Great, king of Persia, a calm, wise and dignified man with a neat dark beard, wearing a Persian royal robe with a fluted crown, standing at the gate of Babylon at sunrise holding a rolled decree scroll; Persian guards with spears and banners behind him and, in the far distance, a long line of Hebrew families with carts beginning the journey home to Jerusalem. Hopeful, majestic, golden-dawn mood.
scenes.ashpenaz: Ashpenaz, chief of the Babylonian court officials: a refined, smooth-faced official in layered Babylonian court robes holding a staff of office, standing in a palace training courtyard with a worried-but-curious expression. Behind him, four young Hebrew men (Daniel and his three friends) are happily eating simple vegetables, grains and water at one table, while another table nearby is piled with rich royal food and wine. Warm, slightly humorous storybook mood.
scenes.queen: The Queen Mother of Babylon, an elegant, composed older woman in a jeweled diadem and a flowing veil and gown of deep teal and gold, calmly entering the grand doorway of a banquet hall where a ghostly glow still lingers; she gestures gracefully with one hand as if recommending a wise man to the frightened king (seen small in the background). Wise, steady, graceful mood, rich palace lighting.
scenes.conspirators: A group of scheming Persian administrators and satraps in elaborate robes and tall caps whispering together in a shadowy palace hall by oil-lamp light, one holding a sealed royal decree scroll with a wax seal, sly sideways glances and conspiratorial smiles; through an archway behind them, a small distant glimpse of Daniel's window glowing warmly. Dark, intriguing, richly shadowed storybook mood.
scenes.gabriel: The archangel Gabriel, a tall radiant angelic messenger with large luminous white-and-pale-gold wings and flowing white robes, standing beside the Ulai river at evening time, extending one hand gently toward young Daniel who kneels in awe with his face toward the ground. Soft rays of golden light and a shimmering celestial glow, palm trees and a distant city silhouette. Reverent, wondrous mood.
scenes.michael: The archangel Michael, a mighty warrior angel with great wings and glowing armor of light, a blazing spear of light in hand, flying through a dark starry storm sky and fighting off swirling shadowy spiritual forces; below, a faint glow over the ancient Persian land. Deep blue and violet sky with brilliant gold-white light. Epic, heroic, protective mood.
scenes.fourth_man: Inside a blazing fiery furnace: three young Hebrew men standing unbound and unharmed amid swirling flames, and a fourth luminous figure walking among them, glowing with warm golden-white light like a heavenly being, the flames bending away from them harmlessly; viewed from the furnace opening, with a small silhouette of astonished King Nebuchadnezzar at the doorway. Awe, wonder and protection.
scenes.ancient_of_days: A vision (Daniel 7:9-10): a majestic throne made of blazing flames, with wheels of burning fire, and a river of fire flowing from before it. Seated upon it is the Ancient of Days, shown as a luminous figure in a garment as white as snow with hair like pure white wool, His face veiled in blinding radiant light (no clear facial features), thousands upon thousands of heavenly attendants and open books around Him, swirling clouds in a deep indigo night sky. Reverent, awe-inspiring, holy mood.
scenes.lions: Inside the lions' den (a deep circular stone pit): several large, majestic Babylonian lions lying down peacefully with closed mouths, tamed, while Daniel stands in the middle completely unharmed and calm, looking up. A single warm golden beam of light shines down from the opening above and a faint luminous angelic glow surrounds him. Gentle, miraculous, serene mood, rich warm stone textures.
scenes.statue: The great statue from Nebuchadnezzar's dream (Daniel 2:31-35): a colossal figure with a head of fine gold, chest and arms of silver, belly and thighs of bronze, legs of iron, and feet of iron mixed with clay. A huge stone cut without hands flies in and strikes the feet; the statue is shattering and its pieces are blown away like chaff by the wind, while the stone grows into a great mountain filling the earth. Dreamlike, dramatic, starry night sky with golden light.
scenes.four_beasts: Daniel's vision (Daniel 7): four great beasts rising from a stormy dark sea churned by the four winds: a lion with eagle's wings, a bear raised on one side with three ribs in its mouth, a leopard with four bird wings and four heads, and a terrifying fourth beast with iron teeth and ten horns plus a small horn with eyes. Stylized dramatic fantasy creatures, dark teal sea, lightning, moody sky. Awe and dread.
scenes.ram_goat: Daniel's vision (Daniel 8): a two-horned ram (one horn longer than the other) charging near a river canal, and a swift goat with one single conspicuous horn between its eyes dashing across the land from the west so fast it does not touch the ground, crashing into the ram. A sunset desert landscape with the palace of Susa far away. Dynamic, stylized, dramatic fantasy-vision mood.

ruth.setting: Setting: ancient Israel and the plains of Moab in the time of the Judges (about 1100 BC) — terraced barley and wheat fields at harvest in warm golden light, sun-baked limestone and mud-brick Bethlehem on a hill, olive trees, a stone city gate with elders' benches, rocky hilltop threshing floors, rustic homespun garments in ochre, indigo, madder red and undyed linen, simple clay jars and woven baskets, women wearing head veils. A pastoral, earthy, golden palette (different from the blue-and-gold of Babylon).

scenes.elimelech: Elimelech, a weary middle-aged Judahite man from Bethlehem in a striped wool robe and headcloth, leading a donkey loaded with bundles out of a parched, famine-stricken Bethlehem; behind him his wife Naomi and two young sons follow. Cracked dry fields, withered barley, a pale hot sky; he glances back at the town with worry and resolve, while the blue-violet hills of Moab lie ahead in the distance.
scenes.naomi: Naomi, an older Israelite woman with gray streaks under her head veil and a weathered, kind face, a bittersweet smile with tears, standing at the entrance of Bethlehem at the start of the barley harvest, golden fields behind her. Beside her, slightly softer in focus, a younger Moabite woman (Ruth) steadies her arm. Warm sunrise light, quiet grief and returning hope.
scenes.mahlon_chilion: Two young Israelite brothers, Mahlon and Chilion, in their twenties, in simple tunics, sitting in the courtyard of a Moabite village house at sunset with their two young Moabite wives and their mother Naomi, sharing a humble meal of bread, lentils and olives. Warm lamplight and long gentle shadows, a tender family moment with a faint note of foreshadowing.
scenes.orpah: Orpah, a young Moabite woman in a deep-blue veil and tunic, kissing her mother-in-law Naomi's cheek goodbye on a dusty road at a crossroads with tears on her face; in the next moment she turns back toward the hills of Moab at dusk, glancing over her shoulder, while Naomi and Ruth stand together a little way off. Tender, sad, sympathetic — not a villain.
scenes.ruth: Ruth, a young Moabite woman with a gentle but fiercely determined face and a madder-red head veil, holding Naomi's hands tightly on the road to Judah, speaking her vow of loyalty; a golden barley harvest and the hill town of Bethlehem glow in the distance under a warm sunrise sky. Devotion, courage and quiet faith.
scenes.bethlehem_women: A group of Bethlehem townswomen in colorful veils and tunics crowding around the town well and gate, astonished and warmly greeting Naomi and Ruth as they arrive on the road (one woman has her hand to her mouth, others reach out); children peek out, barley sheaves and baskets, golden afternoon light. Lively, emotional, community mood.
scenes.boaz: Boaz, a dignified, generous, well-to-do Bethlehem landowner in his late forties with a dark beard streaked with gray, wearing a fine ochre robe and striped mantle, standing among his reapers in a golden barley field greeting them with a warm smile and raised hand ('The LORD be with you'); bound sheaves behind him, and at the field's edge a young woman (Ruth) is seen gleaning. Noble, kind, abundant.
scenes.gleaning: The barley harvest in a Bethlehem field on a golden afternoon: reapers with sickles cutting the grain and binding sheaves, while a young Moabite woman in a madder-red veil (Ruth) bends to gather the fallen ears behind them, a bundle of barley in her arm; a clay water jar, a small shelter, Bethlehem on its hill in the distance. Warm, abundant, hardworking and peaceful.
scenes.overseer: The servant in charge of the reapers: a sturdy, sun-browned middle-aged farm foreman in a short tunic and headcloth with a sickle at his belt, standing at the edge of a barley field, politely explaining and pointing toward a small, distant figure of a young woman gleaning (Ruth) while Boaz listens; reapers working in the background. Warm, down-to-earth, slightly humorous storybook mood.
scenes.threshing_floor: Night on a hilltop threshing floor outside Bethlehem under a starry sky: a large mound of winnowed barley grain and drifting chaff, Boaz a bearded landowner sleeping peacefully wrapped in a woolen blanket at the end of the heap, and Ruth, a young Moabite woman in a madder-red veil, approaching quietly and kneeling respectfully at a modest distance by the foot of his blanket, lantern glow and moonlight. Hushed, tender, respectful and modest — nothing improper.
scenes.kinsman: The nearer kinsman, an unnamed prosperous middle-aged man in a fine fringed robe, sitting among ten elders on stone benches at the arched city gate of Bethlehem in morning light, taking off his sandal and handing it to Boaz as the legal sign of giving up his right of redemption; Boaz stands before him, witnesses and townspeople look on. Formal, dignified, with a hint of reluctance on the kinsman's face.
scenes.obed: Naomi, an older woman with a joyful, tear-bright smile, holding a newborn baby (Obed) swaddled in cloth close to her chest, while Ruth and Boaz stand beside her with happy faces; a warm, simple Bethlehem home with a clay oil lamp, a barley sheaf and woven baskets, neighbor women smiling at the doorway. Soft golden light, peace and restored joy.

jeremiah.setting: Setting: Judah and Jerusalem in the last decades before the Babylonian exile (about 627-580 BC) — honey-colored limestone city walls, the Jerusalem temple mount and its gates, stone cisterns, potters' workshops, olive terraces, and, on the horizon, Neo-Babylonian siege works, banners and soldiers. A dusky, dramatic palette of storm-gray and slate blue skies, ember orange and amber lamplight, ochre stone and ash, with small touches of hope (green shoots, warm dawn light). Garments of undyed linen, indigo and madder red. Serious and emotional, but never gory.

scenes.jeremiah: Jeremiah, the 'weeping prophet': a lean, bearded man in his thirties-forties in a plain, travel-worn linen robe and mantle, standing alone on the top of Jerusalem's city wall at dusk, tears on his face, a scroll in one hand, looking out over the city while dark storm clouds gather from the north; a faint ember-orange glow burns in his chest as if a fire were shut up in his bones. Solemn, tender, resolute.
scenes.josiah: King Josiah, a just young king in a simple royal robe and modest crown, seated at the city gate of Jerusalem hearing the case of the poor: a widow, an orphan child and a ragged farmer stand before him and he leans forward with kind, attentive eyes; bread and a cup of water on a small table beside him; warm morning light, townspeople watching approvingly. Fair, humble and good.
scenes.almond_pot: Split vision: in the foreground a young prophet's hand holds a flowering almond branch with white-pink blossoms (early-spring 'watching tree'), while behind it, over a shadowy northern horizon, a huge boiling pot tilts toward Judah, steam and sparks pouring toward the south; moody dusk sky. Symbolic, vivid, dramatic.
scenes.false_prophets: A group of smooth, well-fed prophets and priests in fine embroidered robes smiling reassuringly at a trusting crowd and gesturing 'peace, peace' with open palms, while behind them dark storm clouds, a cracked city wall and a distant approaching army are ignored; a lone worried older man in the crowd looks over his shoulder. Ironic, theatrical, ominous.
scenes.temple_sermon: Jeremiah standing in the gateway of the Jerusalem temple with raised arms, addressing a crowd of worshippers who stream in carrying lambs, doves and baskets of offerings; the grand temple behind him, merchants and a money-changer's table at the side; some listeners look angry, some ashamed. Stormy gold-and-gray sky. Bold, confrontational, dramatic.
scenes.potter: A potter at his foot-driven wheel in a workshop near Jerusalem, shaping wet clay: a vessel on the wheel has collapsed and he is gently reshaping it into a new vessel with patient hands; Jeremiah stands beside the wheel watching with thoughtful eyes; shelves of clay jars, drying pots, warm earthen light through the doorway. Craftsmanship, patience, hope.
scenes.pashhur: Pashhur, a stern priest and temple officer in white-and-blue priestly garments with an official's staff, at the Upper Gate of Benjamin in the temple compound at dawn, having Jeremiah locked into wooden stocks; Pashhur's face is angry and smug, guards stand by, onlookers whisper; Jeremiah, in the stocks, holds his head up steadfastly. Tense, unjust, with quiet courage.
scenes.jehoiakim: King Jehoiakim in a luxurious winter room, seated by a glowing brazier, calmly slicing a scroll into strips with a scribe's knife and tossing the pieces into the fire; the king's face is cold and defiant; two officials plead with him with raised hands while others look away; flames light the carved cedar panels. Dramatic, chilling.
scenes.figs: Two woven baskets set in front of the Jerusalem temple: one overflowing with ripe, sweet early figs glowing purple-green, the other full of rotten, shriveled figs too bad to eat; Jeremiah kneels between them looking at the baskets with a shaft of warm light on the good ones; the temple and city in the soft distance. Clear, symbolic, painterly.
scenes.yoke: Jeremiah walking through a busy Jerusalem street wearing a wooden ox yoke with leather straps across his shoulders, as a living sign; envoys from neighboring nations (Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon) in distinct colorful costumes watch him with puzzled, curious faces; market stalls, dust, bright daylight. Striking, slightly absurd, serious.
scenes.hananiah: Hananiah, a confident prophet in elaborate fringed robes, in the temple court wrenching the wooden yoke off Jeremiah's neck and breaking it over his knee, wood splinters flying, in front of priests and a delighted crowd; Jeremiah stands sorrowful and silent in the foreground. Theatrical, tense, with a sense of coming consequences.
scenes.letter_exiles: Judean exiles beside the canals of Babylon, no longer weeping but building mud-brick houses, planting vegetable gardens and sharing a meal; a courier has just handed a rolled letter to an elder who reads it aloud to a gathering of hopeful families; in the distance the blue-glazed Ishtar Gate of Babylon. Homesick yet hopeful, warm evening light.
scenes.rachel: At Ramah at dusk: a grieving mother figure (Rachel, symbolic) kneeling by a stone pillar on a hilltop, weeping with her hands over her face, while below on the road a long line of exiles with bundles and chained captives is led away toward the north; the sky is soft purple-gray with one thin ray of golden light breaking through on the horizon. Sorrowful, tender, with a hint of hope.
scenes.new_covenant: Symbolic illustration of the new covenant: cracked stone tablets lie broken on the ground, and above them a luminous scroll unrolls whose golden light flows into the open hands and chests of a diverse group of ordinary people — an old man, a woman, a young man, a child — as if written on their hearts; a green valley and a new dawn glow behind them. No text or letters at all. Radiant, intimate, hopeful.
scenes.anathoth_field: Jeremiah, imprisoned in the court of the guard during the siege, signing a deed of purchase for a field from his cousin Hanamel: seventeen silver shekels weighed on a small balance, witnesses watching, and the sealed scroll and an open copy being placed into a clay jar by a scribe; through a window the besieging ramps and Babylonian tents are visible, while a warm lamp lights the table. An act of hope in the midst of ruin.
scenes.baruch: Baruch son of Neriah, a young earnest scribe with a reed pen and ink horn, writing on a long scroll in a small lamp-lit room as Jeremiah, seen in profile and partly in shadow, dictates; stacks of rolled scrolls, clay jars, a window with the night sky. Focused, loyal, intimate.
scenes.rechabites: A Rechabite family of nomads — father, mother, sons and children in simple dark woolen tunics — standing politely in a temple chamber with bowls and cups of wine set before them, the father gently pushing the cup away with an open hand; Jeremiah and temple officials watch with respect; through the doorway their tents are visible. Quiet integrity and loyalty.
scenes.scroll: Close view of a long half-burnt scroll lying on a table with glowing embers and ash at its charred edge, while beside it a young scribe's hand writes a fresh scroll by candlelight with a reed pen, an ink horn and a second blank scroll ready; deep shadows and warm candle glow. The word of God cannot be burned away.
scenes.zedekiah: King Zedekiah, a nervous, indecisive young king in royal robes, meeting Jeremiah in secret at night in a torch-lit corridor at the third entrance of the temple, glancing over his shoulder in fear of his officials; through an arch behind them the campfires of the Babylonian army ring Jerusalem on the hills. Anxious, conflicted, atmospheric.
scenes.cistern: Jeremiah at the bottom of a deep, dark stone cistern, standing knee-deep in mud and looking up toward a single shaft of light from the round opening high above, where worn-out rags and old clothes are being lowered to him on ropes; damp walls, tired but alive. Claustrophobic, with a gleam of rescue.
scenes.ebed_melech: Ebed-Melech, a dignified Cushite (Nubian) court official in colorful royal-household robes and a headcloth, leaning over the mouth of a cistern with several men, lowering a rope with old rags and worn clothes to rescue Jeremiah below; his face shows compassion and resolve; afternoon light on the palace courtyard. Courageous, kind, respectful portrayal.
scenes.nebuzaradan: Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian captain of the guard in Neo-Babylonian scale armor and a crested helmet, standing among smoking ruins at Ramah beside a lines of captives, formally unlocking Jeremiah's chains and offering him a choice with an open-handed gesture; Jeremiah rubs his wrists; smoke and ember sky behind. Grave, unexpected kindness.
scenes.gedaliah: Gedaliah, the calm, sensible governor appointed over the remnant of Judah, at Mizpah welcoming returning Judeans who bring baskets of summer fruit, wine and olive oil among rebuilt walls and green vines; farmers harvest in the background; at the far edge of the scene, half in shadow, a hooded man watches (a hint of coming betrayal). Hopeful, peaceful, with quiet foreboding.

lamentations.setting: Setting: Jerusalem in the days right after the Babylonian conquest (586 BC) — the honey-colored limestone city walls broken, burned gates, soot-blackened stones, rubble, thin smoke, scorched olive trees and the ruined temple mount at dusk or night. A hushed, mournful palette of ash gray, dusk violet, deep indigo, ember orange and moonlight, with a single small gleam of hope (a thin dawn light, a green sprout) in some scenes. Garments are torn, dusty linen and dark mourning wool. Sorrowful and dignified, never gory or graphic.

scenes.zion: Daughter Zion, the city of Jerusalem personified as a woman: a veiled woman in dark mourning garments sitting alone at the broken city gate at night, her face wet with tears in the moonlight, hands outstretched with no one to comfort her; behind her the ruined, silent city under a violet sky. A widow-like figure: lonely, dignified and heartbreaking.
scenes.sanctuary: The ruined temple of Jerusalem after its destruction: broken stone pillars and a toppled altar, charred cedar beams, thin smoke rising, and a few jackals prowling over the desolate Mount Zion at dusk; the sky glows dull orange and violet. Grand, empty, mournful.
scenes.passersby: A road past the ruined city gate: a crowd of travelers and merchants stopping to stare — some clap their hands and wag their heads in mockery, some point and hiss — while a single veiled woman (Zion) sits motionless at the gate with bowed head; one older traveler looks back with a flicker of pity. Cold afternoon light, ash in the air.
scenes.children: A street in the ruined, hungry city: a young mother with a thin, weeping infant in her arms and two small children beside her holding out empty hands, asking for bread, while passing adults look away helplessly; an empty clay bread jar and a bare oven. Tender, sorrowful, gentle and non-graphic, soft gray light.
scenes.false_visions: A group of well-dressed prophets and priests proclaiming glittering, grand 'visions' with theatrical gestures to a thin, hungry, trusting crowd, while behind them a stone wall visibly cracks and the city's defenses crumble; one prophet holds a decorated scroll. Dusky amber light, ironic and ominous.
scenes.afflicted_man: A man in a torn robe sitting alone in darkness among ruins, walled in by heaped stones and hung with a heavy chain, head bowed with weary resignation, a single thin shaft of pale light falling from far above; the sense of being hemmed in. Deep indigo shadows, a small ember of life in his eyes.
scenes.mercies: A new dawn breaking over the ruins of Jerusalem: golden morning light spreading across the broken walls, a small green olive sprout growing between the stones in the foreground, and a man kneeling with lifted face and open hands, eyes closed in trust. The mood turns from night to hope: 'new every morning'. Radiant but humble, warm gold against cool violet.
scenes.nazirites: Two groups of men in the ash-covered streets of the ruined city: in a faint memory-like glow behind them, radiant, healthy consecrated young men with long hair (Nazirites) in white; in the foreground the same kind of men now gaunt, sooty and unrecognizable, sitting against a burned wall. A contrast of former purity and present ruin, tender and solemn.
scenes.edom: The Daughter of Edom rejoicing: a proud, richly dressed woman in a lavish tent on the red rocky heights of Seir, lifting a cup and laughing at a feast while, in the shadow behind her, a great dark cup tilts toward her as a sign of her own coming judgment; the distant smoke of Jerusalem on the horizon. Rich red-ochre rocks and an ominous dusk.
scenes.elders_young: At the city gate: elderly elders sitting silent on the ground in sackcloth with dust on their heads and gray hair; beside them young men bent over heavy hand-mills grinding grain and boys staggering under loads of wood; the usual music and gate-gatherings are gone; weary slate-blue light. Quiet, heavy, dignified.
scenes.prayer: The surviving community kneeling among the ruins at first light: elders, women, young men and children with hands lifted toward a pale dawn sky, pleading in prayer, the broken walls and a smoking Mount Zion behind them; a thin band of gold on the horizon. Humble, united, hopeful. Painterly and solemn.
scenes.acrostic: A lamenting poet seated beside a low oil lamp in a ruined room, writing a long poem on a scroll with a reed pen; along the stone sill beside him stand twenty-two small clay oil lamps in an orderly row, each with a small steady flame, like a line of ordered grief; a window shows the ruined city at night. No text or letters at all. Quiet, orderly, intimate.

ezekiel.setting: Setting: the Judean exiles in Babylonia beside the Kebar canal (about 593-570 BC) — mud-brick houses, date palms, irrigation canals, flat riverside plains under huge skies — and Ezekiel's visions of Jerusalem and a restored temple. A visionary, majestic palette: electric blue and storm gray, amber, fire-orange and white-gold radiance, rainbow light, with earthy ochre for the exiles' world. Garments of undyed linen, indigo and madder red; priestly linen for Ezekiel. Awe-inspiring and surreal for the visions, quiet and human for the sign-acts, never gory.

scenes.ezekiel: Ezekiel, a priest-prophet in his thirties with a dark beard, in a priestly linen-and-blue robe, sitting among exiles by the Kebar canal under date palms and mud-brick huts, looking up awestruck at a stormy sky where a luminous fiery cloud and a rainbow-like radiance are breaking open; an overwhelmed, watchful expression.
scenes.wheels: Ezekiel's vision of the living creatures: a storm wind out of the north with a great cloud, flashing fire and amber brilliance, four winged living creatures each with four faces (human, lion, ox, eagle) moving in unison, and great wheels within wheels rimmed with eyes beside them; above them a shining crystal-like expanse. Awe-inspiring, surreal and majestic. No text.
scenes.eaten_scroll: A hand reaching down out of radiant golden light holding out an unrolled scroll covered with marks on both sides (abstract marks, not letters), and Ezekiel kneeling, eating the scroll with wide, astonished eyes and a faint taste of sweetness on his face; honey-gold light, a stormy sky behind. Surreal and intimate.
scenes.watchman: Ezekiel as a watchman on a city wall tower at night with a ram's-horn trumpet raised in his hand, looking out toward the campfires of an approaching enemy on the dark plain; the sleeping city below, stars and a thin moon; tense, responsible and alert.
scenes.siege_brick: Ezekiel sitting on the ground beside a large clay brick scratched with a miniature siege of Jerusalem (tiny siege ramps, camps, battering rams, an iron pan standing like a wall), and then lying on his side bound with ropes beside it while puzzled exiles in a canal-side village look on. A strange, quiet, sign-act scene.
scenes.abominations: A secret chamber behind a hole in the wall of the Jerusalem temple: dark walls carved with images of creeping things and beasts, seventy elders standing in thick incense smoke, each with a censer; Ezekiel, guided by a glowing figure, peers in with horror; in the corner women sit weeping, and outside men bow toward the rising sun with their backs to the temple. Dim, ominous, smoky amber light.
scenes.mark_forehead: A man dressed in white linen with a scribe's inkhorn at his belt, passing through Jerusalem's streets and marking the foreheads of men who sigh and weep over the city's evils, while behind him six figures with weapons wait; a dusky street, a lamp-lit doorway; tense but hopeful — the faithful are marked.
scenes.glory: The glory of the LORD: a vast blazing radiance with wheeled cherubim rising up from the threshold of the temple and lifting away over the east gate and the Mount of Olives, the temple left dim and silent below; Ezekiel kneeling in the foreground with his face to the ground. Majestic, sorrowful and overwhelming white-gold light.
scenes.exile_baggage: Ezekiel at dusk digging through the mud-brick wall of his own house, carrying out a bundle of belongings on his shoulder with his face covered, as a sign of exile; neighbors watch from doorways with puzzled and uneasy faces; the canal and palms in the background.
scenes.whitewash: A flimsy crumbling wall being brushed with bright whitewash by smiling, well-dressed false prophets while a violent storm with hail and rising flood approaches on the horizon; the people watching trustingly, one worried onlooker pointing at the cracks. Ironic and ominous.
scenes.foundling: An abandoned newborn baby girl lying in an open field at dawn, and a passing traveler kneeling to gently lift her and wrap her in the edge of his cloak; soft sunrise over the empty field, wildflowers; tender, modest and compassionate (no nudity at all; the baby is fully wrapped).
scenes.sour_grapes: In a sunlit vineyard a father eats sour grapes and his young adult son winces with puckered face and teeth on edge; the son then tosses the bitter basket aside and turns toward fresh ripe grapes and a bright sunrise path, as the father watches. A hopeful scene about personal responsibility.
scenes.ezekiel_wife: Ezekiel standing silent and composed at dusk by the closed door of his house, turban on his head and sandals on his feet, while on a bench beside him lies a woman's folded embroidered shawl next to an empty chair and a lit oil lamp; neighbors in the lane look at him in bewilderment. Quiet, restrained grief; no wailing.
scenes.tyre_ship: The great merchant ship of Tyre sailing a calm blue sea: a magnificent vessel with cypress planks, a cedar mast, oak oars and a sail of embroidered linen in blue and purple, rowers and sailors from Sidon and Arvad, bales of goods; the island city of Tyre on the horizon; at the far edge, dark towering waves gather ominously. Grand and foreboding.
scenes.pharaoh_dragon: Pharaoh of Egypt as a huge crocodile-dragon lying in the Nile among its streams, boasting proudly, with fish clinging to its scales and a great hook set in its jaws pulling it toward the bank; pyramids and papyrus reeds behind. A stylized, dramatic fantasy illustration, not gory.
scenes.shepherds: Left side: self-serving shepherds feasting at a table while thin, scattered sheep wander lost on rocky hills. Right side: a gentle Shepherd with a staff, seen mostly from behind in warm backlight with his face not shown, gathering the scattered sheep and carrying an injured sheep in his arms toward green pasture at dawn. Compassionate, hopeful, pastoral.
scenes.new_heart: A gray stone heart cracking open in cupped hands to reveal a living, warm, glowing heart inside, with clear water sprinkling down from above and a small green sprout growing from the fissure; a sunrise glow behind. Symbolic, tender and hopeful. No text.
scenes.dry_bones: A broad valley covered with dry bones; Ezekiel stands among them with one arm raised, speaking; the bones are rattling together, sinews and flesh softly forming, and a great wind sweeps in from the four directions as an enormous crowd of people rises to stand; dramatic dawn light and swirling wind. Awe-inspiring and not gory.
scenes.two_sticks: Ezekiel holding two wooden sticks carved with different simple tribal markings (no letters) and joining them into one stick in his hand, which glows with warm light; two groups of people from different clans gather behind him, clasping hands; dusk with hopeful golden light.
scenes.gog: A vast mixed army of northern nations — horsemen, chariots, shields, banners — storming down from the north toward a peaceful open hill country with unwalled villages, while a fiery storm of hail, lightning and rolling thunder breaks over them from the heavens and the army falls into confusion; apocalyptic sky; epic but not gory.
scenes.measuring_man: A radiant man whose appearance is like gleaming bronze, standing at a great temple gateway with a flax cord and a measuring reed in his hands, guiding Ezekiel, who gazes up in wonder, through the vast, perfectly ordered new temple complex with gates, courts and chambers; clear blue morning light and crisp stone geometry.
scenes.temple_river: A river flowing from beneath the threshold of a temple eastward, shown in stages: ankle-deep, knee-deep, deeper and then a mighty stream too deep to cross; the radiant man with a measuring line leads Ezekiel along the bank; abundant fruit trees line both banks and fish teem in the water as the desert turns green; luminous morning. Joyful, life-giving, majestic.

hosea.setting: Setting: the northern kingdom of Israel in the 8th century BC (about 755-722 BC) — the hill country of Ephraim, grain fields, vineyards and fig trees, the fertile Jezreel Valley, the hilltop capital Samaria, village houses of stone and mud-brick with olive-oil lamps, shrines at Bethel, with the shadow of Assyria on the horizon. A warm, domestic and emotional palette: golden wheat, terracotta, olive green, dawn dew and soft lamplight, with storm gray for judgment scenes. Garments of undyed linen, indigo and madder red. Intimate, tender and sorrowful rather than epic; never sexualized or gory.

scenes.hosea: Hosea, a humble prophet in his thirties or forties with a kind, heartbroken but steadfast face, in a simple robe, standing at a village doorway at dusk holding a small cloth bundle of barley and a little bag of silver, looking out toward the road where someone is missing; a ripe grain field and a hill-town behind him. Quiet, faithful love.
scenes.gomer: Gomer, a young woman in colorful but slightly wilted festival clothing with a conflicted, wistful expression, standing at a crossroads: on one side a modest home with a warm lamp-lit doorway where Hosea's silhouette waits, on the other a lively evening market street with bright lanterns and strangers; dusk light. Sympathetic and human, not sexualized.
scenes.hosea_children: Three small children in a village courtyard: a young boy holding a basket of seed, a little girl clutching a rag doll with a sad face, and a toddler boy hiding shyly behind her, while their father Hosea kneels and gathers them in his arms; warm lamplight, the green Jezreel Valley in the distance. Tender and a little sorrowful.
scenes.wilderness_courtship: A young woman walking alone at dawn along a rocky wilderness path, looking up with a hopeful, wondering face; ahead the hills open in a gap shaped like an open doorway glowing with golden light, with green vineyards visible beyond it; a gentle ray of light reaches toward her like an extended hand. Hopeful and romantic in a pure, tender way.
scenes.betrothal: A symbolic betrothal scene: a woman in a white-and-blue veil with a flower garland, her hands gently clasped with a man's hands and bound together with a woven cord, under a wedding canopy of vines and flowers; around them five softly glowing oil lamps stand in a row. Warm golden light, vineyards behind. Pure, joyful and solemn. No text.
scenes.redemption: In a village market, Hosea counts out fifteen silver coins and measures of barley to a seller to buy back a downcast young woman who stands with lowered head and tear-streaked face; Hosea gently drapes his cloak over her shoulders; onlookers murmur among the stalls. Compassionate, dignified, with golden afternoon light.
scenes.no_knowledge: A dusty shrine-town square: priests in fine robes turn their backs on an unrolled scroll left lying neglected on a stone step while villagers wander aimlessly toward a small idol; a thin family looks on, withered fields and languishing animals behind them, a dry stream; dull, heavy light. Sad, ironic and bleak.
scenes.morning_mist: A cheerful crowd of Israelites walking toward a hilltop shrine saying 'come, let us return', their faces bright and eager, while behind them the morning mist and dew are already burning off the grass in the rising sun; Hosea watches from the side with a sad, knowing look. Delicate, fleeting, lyrical.
scenes.desire_mercy: A big stone altar piled with lavish sacrifices — a fat ox, baskets of grain — and priests proudly standing beside it, while in the foreground an ordinary villager kneels to give bread and water to a hungry stranger; golden light falls on the small act of mercy rather than on the altar. Warm, humane and quietly pointed.
scenes.ephraim: Ephraim personified as a hapless young man in fine northern-style clothes, standing beside a hearth where a round flat cake of bread is burnt black on one side and raw on the other, with some gray hairs sprinkled on his head that he hasn't noticed; around him a silly dove flutters foolishly between an Assyrian envoy on one side and an Egyptian envoy on the other. Gently comic yet sad.
scenes.samaria_calf: A calf idol on a pedestal in a hilltop shrine at Bethel, small and obviously handmade, with a craftsman polishing it nearby and worshipers bowing and kissing it; a storm gathers over the hills behind them, and an unnoticed small cloud of smoke rises. Ironic, ominous mood.
scenes.whirlwind: A farmer sowing seed by hand across a field whose seed whirls up into little dust devils; on the horizon a huge whirlwind rolls toward him, uprooting the headless stalks of grain; stormy yellow-gray sky. Grim and dramatic but not gory.
scenes.fallow_ground: A farmer breaking up hard, unplowed ground with a wooden plow and a pair of oxen in early spring, scattering golden glowing seeds, while rain clouds part and a gentle shower of light falls from the sky; the dark broken furrows are fresh and rich. Hopeful, humble and bright.
scenes.father_heart: A father kneeling in a green morning meadow, holding a toddler's arms to teach him to walk, bending down with gentle love; the child glances back over his shoulder toward distant wandering paths; far behind, the faint shapes of Egyptian pyramids and a river. Warm, intimate, tender morning light.
scenes.ransom: A dark cavernous realm of the dead whose heavy gates burst open with light pouring in from a dawn sky, and a strong hand reaching down to lift a figure out of the shadows while others look up toward the light; heroic, hopeful and majestic, not gory.
scenes.dew: Early morning in a restored garden: heavy dew sparkling on blossoming lilies, a young cedar tree with deep roots, olive trees and grapevines glowing in the sunrise, a luminous gentle mist; a small family walks among the growing grain and flowers smiling. Serene, fragrant and renewed, soft golden-green light.

joel.setting: Setting: ancient Judah around Jerusalem and Mount Zion with the temple (the book is undated), in a farming landscape of terraced vineyards, fig and pomegranate trees, wheat fields, threshing floors and wine presses under big skies. A dramatic palette that moves from scorched ochre, ash-gray and swarming dark brown (the locust plague and the dark day) to renewed green, gold, rain-blue and wine-red (restoration and the outpoured Spirit). Garments of undyed linen, wool, indigo and madder red; sackcloth for mourning. Awe-inspiring and urgent rather than gory.

scenes.joel: Joel, a prophet in his thirties with a dark beard and an urgent, earnest face, in a simple wool robe, standing on the temple steps in Jerusalem holding a ram's horn trumpet lowered in one hand and gesturing outward with the other; behind him on one side a dark storm of locusts looms over the hills, and on the other a gentle golden dawn breaks over Mount Zion. Alert, sorrowful and hopeful.
scenes.locusts: A farm valley devoured by locusts: a thick brown cloud of locusts of different sizes (some winged, some wingless crawling young) blankets the fields; fig trees and vines stripped to bare white branches, wheat reduced to stubble, farmers kneeling in the dust in despair with their hands on their heads; a farm child holding an empty basket. Grim, dusty light, no gore. No text.
scenes.mourning_priests: Priests in sackcloth weeping at the temple altar, lying on the stones overnight, the altar bare with no grain offering or wine offering on it, an empty offering table and shuttered storerooms; elders and farmers in the courtyard behind them with bowed heads, an empty wine cup tipped over; dim, mournful lamplight. Somber and quiet.
scenes.day_of_lord: A dramatic sky over Mount Zion: a thick dark day of clouds and gloom, the sun dimmed and the moon turning blood red, an eerie dawn-like glow spreading over the mountains like a great force approaching, villagers trembling and looking up, a priest on the city wall sounding a ram's horn alarm. Epic, ominous and awe-inspiring, not gory.
scenes.locust_army: A swarm of locusts marching like a disciplined army: row upon row with horse-like heads, climbing a city wall and pouring through the windows of houses like thieves, shadows pressing over a hill town; before them the land is a green Eden-like garden, behind them a burnt wilderness; soldiers on the wall helplessly hold their spears. Stylized, dramatic fantasy illustration, not gory.
scenes.rend_heart: A great assembly at the temple porch: men and women in plain mourning clothes, a young bridegroom and bride called out of their wedding rooms, elders, children and even nursing babies gathered, priests weeping between the porch and the altar; in the foreground a man holds his untorn garment with one hand and presses his other hand to his chest with tears, as a warm shaft of light breaks through the gloom onto the group. Tender and repentant.
scenes.early_rain: Joyful farmers and families on a Judean threshing floor with arms raised and faces turned up to a gentle autumn and spring rain falling on cracked dry ground that is turning green; threshing floors heaped with golden wheat, wine vats and oil jars overflowing, children laughing and splashing; hopeful bright light breaking through rain clouds.
scenes.restored_years: A restored harvest: an elderly farmer and his grandchildren eating a full, happy meal of bread, figs and grapes under a fig tree with fresh new leaves; the vineyard behind them lush after the plague, a few old stripped stumps sprouting green shoots; golden afternoon light, gratitude and abundance.
scenes.spirit_poured: A gathering outdoors of people of every age and station: gray-haired old men dreaming in peaceful sleep with soft visions of light drifting above them, young men gazing up at shining visions, sons and daughters speaking excitedly, servants and maidservants among them, all bathed in a gentle shower of luminous golden light pouring down from above like rain (not flames); joyful and awed faces, warm hills behind. Radiant, hopeful and communal.
scenes.call_on_name: A dark landscape under strange signs in the sky: a black sun and a blood-red moon, columns of smoke and distant fire; on Mount Zion a lamp-lit refuge gate stands open, with frightened people fleeing up the path toward it, and a young woman at the front lifting her arms and calling out aloud, her face lit by the lamplight; tense but hopeful.
scenes.valley_decision: A vast valley filled with multitudes of soldiers and people from many nations in varied ancient dress, gathered under a dramatic sky; a huge sickle-shaped crescent moon over the valley, rolling storm clouds, a ripe harvest field and an overflowing wine press at the valley's edge; on the high ridge above, Zion glows with a column of light. Epic and solemn, not gory.
scenes.plowshares: A village forge at dusk: blacksmiths hammering plowshares into swords and pruning hooks into spears with sparks flying; farmers handing over their tools reluctantly, a thin weak man flexing his arm and shouting with false bravado, a mother watching anxiously from the doorway; heavy orange forge light against a darkening sky. Tense and unsettling, not gory.
scenes.fountain: A spring of clear water flowing out from beneath the threshold of the temple and down through Judean hills into a dry valley, turning it green; terraced vineyards heavy with grapes on the mountains, flocks of sheep and goats grazing on the hills, streams in the brooks, people washing and drinking and laughing along the banks; luminous, peaceful golden light.

amos.setting: Setting: the 8th century BC, in the reigns of Uzziah of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel — a prosperous but unjust age. Amos is a shepherd and sycamore-fig dresser from Tekoa in the dry hills of Judah, sent north to Bethel and Samaria, where wealthy people lounge on ivory-inlaid couches, feast on lamb and calves, and trade at crooked scales while the poor are sold for a pair of sandals. A palette of dusty ochre, sheep-wool cream and olive green for Amos's world; lavish wine red, gold and ivory for the rich of Samaria; storm gray, ember orange and darkness for the warnings; fresh green and dawn gold for the final restoration. Garments of undyed wool and linen, indigo and madder red. Stern and dramatic, never gory.

scenes.amos: Amos, a weathered, sturdy shepherd in his forties with a dark beard and sun-lined face, in a rough undyed wool cloak, holding a shepherd's staff in one hand and a basket of sycamore figs on his arm, standing on a rocky hill above Tekoa at dawn with his flock of sheep around him; behind him in the distance the hills of the northern kingdom rise under heavy storm clouds; a reluctant but steady resolve in his eyes.
scenes.three_four: A sweeping panoramic scene of a prophet's voice sweeping across the ancient nations: along a long ridge a row of walled city-gates and palaces (Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, Moab, Judah, Israel) each with a single bolt of fire falling from the storm sky onto one of its palaces; Amos, small in the foreground, holds up three fingers and then a fourth, looking steadily outward. Epic, stylized, not gory. No text.
scenes.sold_for_sandals: A city-gate marketplace in Samaria: a wealthy merchant counting out silver coins and weighing grain on a crooked balance with a heavy stone and a small measure, while on the ground before him a poor, thin man in a patched tunic kneels with a worn pair of sandals set beside him as the price; a righteous elder is held by the arm; onlookers murmur; Amos watches from the side with stern grief. Dignified depiction, no violence.
scenes.lion_roars: A lion roaring on a rocky ridge at the edge of a forest at dusk, with villagers in a nearby town startled and looking up; in the foreground a shepherd holds up two sheep leg-bones and a bit of ear rescued from the lion's mouth; on the ground a bird snare with a net; on the town wall a watchman has just blown a ram's horn. A tense, dramatic composition; not gory.
scenes.ivory_beds: A lavish banquet in a hillside mansion in Samaria: wealthy men and well-fed women lounging on couches inlaid with ivory, a table loaded with roast lamb and calves, harps being strummed, large wine bowls and fine oil jars; a woman waves a servant to bring more wine; through the open doorway a thin ragged beggar waits on the step while a storm gathers on the horizon. Ironic, decadent but not sexualized.
scenes.yet_not_returned: A bleak panorama of afflictions: a drought-stricken field with a single rain cloud pouring on one town while the neighboring field is parched and cracked; villagers carrying empty water jars from town to town; blighted grain and vines eaten by caterpillars; in the foreground a half-burnt stick plucked from the fire lies on the dry ground; a small figure stands looking up with hollow eyes. Somber, windswept light.
scenes.seek_and_live: A traveler at a fork in the road at dawn, turning away from a crowded pilgrim road leading to a hilltop shrine at Bethel and choosing a bright narrow path through the hills; above him in the fading night sky the Pleiades and Orion constellations are visible and the darkness is turning to a golden sunrise; a prophet gestures toward the dawn. Hopeful, serene and luminous.
scenes.day_of_darkness: A man running down a dim path in a thick gloomy dusk: a lion behind him, a bear on the path ahead, and a house wall beside him where a snake strikes as he leans on it; in the far background cheerful festival-goers with torches expect light, but the sky overhead is pitch dark with a pale dim sun; tense and ominous, stylized and not gory.
scenes.justice_river: A mighty river of clear water rolling like a flood through a dry wadi and across the square of a hilltop shrine town in the middle of a festival: worshipers with harps, burnt offerings and festival banners stand aside, startled, as the river rushes past; a prophet stands on the bank with an arm raised; bright rolling water catching golden sunlight. Awe-inspiring, hopeful and majestic.
scenes.amos_intercession: Amos kneeling in prayer at dusk on a hilltop with hands raised, tears on his face; behind him on the left a swarm of locusts descending over a green field and on the right a great wall of fire licking over a far valley; a gentle shaft of light falls on him from above and softens the glow of the sky. Compassionate and urgent.
scenes.plumb_line: A heavy plumb line on a cord hanging from a bright hand of light reaching down from the sky (no face, only a radiant hand), beside a leaning, bulging city wall of stone; a small figure of Amos stands in the foreground looking up and seeing; some stones are slipping loose and dust drifts down; dusk light with a faint orange sky. Solemn and symbolic.
scenes.amaziah: A richly dressed priest of Bethel (Amaziah), in fine robes with a priestly turban, standing at the steps of the king's sanctuary pointing sternly toward the road, while Amos, a plain shepherd with a staff and a basket of sycamore figs, stands calmly and firmly facing him; temple guards and incense smoke behind the priest; golden morning light; a quiet but tense confrontation.
scenes.summer_fruit: Amos holding a wide basket of ripe summer fruit — figs, pomegranates, grapes, dates — so ripe it is on the edge of spoiling, a few flies hovering, in the golden glow of a late summer sunset; in the distance below the hill a procession of mourners in sackcloth moves slowly through a town in place of festival singers; a still, foreboding mood.
scenes.word_famine: A group of thirsty, weary people — young men and young women — wandering across a vast arid landscape from sea to sea under a sky where the sun has darkened at noon, with baskets of bread and jars of water beside them untouched, looking toward the empty horizon and searching with hollow eyes; a lone empty stone lectern and a closed scroll on the ground. Haunting, quiet and symbolic.
scenes.sieve: A farmer on a threshing floor shaking a big sieve so that the grain scatters in the wind, with not one grain falling to the ground wasted; in the distant background different peoples — dark-skinned Cushites, Philistines, Arameans and Israelites in their distinct garb — each walk along their own roads under one wide evening sky; solemn, symbolic and warm gold light.
scenes.fallen_tent: A collapsed old shepherd-king's tent (David's tent), torn cloth sagging on broken poles amid ruins, with strong hands setting the poles upright and stitching the tear, and a gentle sunrise gleaming through; around it returning exiles rebuild houses, plant vineyards and plow while another reaps, grapevines heavy on the mountains and golden wheat in the valley; joyful, warm, restorative light.

obadiah.setting: Setting: the rugged rocky highlands of ancient Edom (Mount Seir) south-east of Judah: steep sandstone cliffs in rose, rust and ochre, deep clefts and cave dwellings carved high in the rock, narrow canyons, a few terraced vineyards, caravan tracks and mountain passes, with the green terraced hills of Judah and Mount Zion with the temple in the contrasting distance. Palette of warm red-orange rock, dusty gold, stormy violet-gray skies and, for the hope scenes, fresh green and gold. Garments of undyed linen, wool, indigo and madder red, simple leather sandals, desert head cloths for Edomites. Solemn, proud and dramatic rather than gory.

scenes.obadiah: Obadiah, a prophet in his forties with a short dark beard and a stern, attentive face, in a plain wool robe and head cloth, standing on a ridge between two landscapes: behind him on one side the red rocky cliffs of Edom under storm clouds, on the other the green hills of Judah and Mount Zion in soft light; he holds a small scroll in one hand and raises the other as if relaying a message he has just heard, a faint beam of light falling on him from the clouds. Serious and earnest.
scenes.edom_pride: A proud mountain fortress city carved into towering red sandstone cliffs high above a canyon: stone houses and cave dwellings in the clefts, a king-like Edomite chieftain in a striped robe standing on a high ledge with arms folded and chin raised, looking down at the clouds; a huge eagle's nest built at the very top among the stars at dusk, and a giant unseen hand of golden light reaching down from the sky above the peaks. Majestic and ominous, not gory.
scenes.esau_jacob: Two brothers, twins in early middle age, standing apart on a road at dusk: one a ruddy hairy hunter in a fur-trimmed tunic with a bow on his back who looks away with folded arms (Esau), the other a gentler shepherd in a striped wool robe holding a staff who looks toward him sadly (Jacob); behind the hunter a red mountain range, behind the shepherd green pastures and a flock; a bowl of red stew and an old tent in the lower corner hinting at their history. Tense and melancholy, two matching profiles.
scenes.ransacked: A ransacked mountain hideout in a rock cleft: chests and jars thrown open and emptied, hidden treasure rooms searched out behind a pulled-aside false wall, scattered coins and cloth, strangers' torch-lit silhouettes carrying things away; in the foreground a small thief on a night road and a grape picker leaving a few gleaning bunches on a vine, contrasting with the total emptiness behind. Dim torchlight, no gore.
scenes.false_friends: A shared meal turned sour: at a long low table in a tent, men in Edomite striped robes eat bread and drink, while one smiling ally under the table sets out a hidden rope snare and another quietly slips a dagger sleeve; in the background envoys escort the host politely to the border stones, then turn their backs; the host, a rich Edomite lord, is oblivious, raising his cup. Warm lamplight with cold shadows, subtle and tense, not gory.
scenes.teman_wise: A wise-men's gate in the Edomite town of Teman: elders and sages in long robes gathered with scrolls and counsel stones under the gate arch, a lamp of wisdom that is guttering and going dark; beside them armored mighty warriors with spears and round shields, looking up in alarm at a gathering storm over the red cliffs; dust rising and a quiet sense of fear. Solemn, dusk light.
scenes.stood_aside: A besieged city of Jerusalem at dusk seen from a crossroads: foreign soldiers carrying away treasure and casting lots on a cloak at the city gate; in the foreground, an Edomite man in a striped robe stands on the other side of the road with folded arms, watching and smiling thinly, his shadow merging with the invaders'; behind him two companions at a fork in the road block the path of fleeing refugees with children and bundles. Sorrowful and morally heavy, no gore.
scenes.deeds_return: A great boomerang-like turning of fortune: a vast bronze scale or turning wheel in a stormy sky above a crowd of many nations in varied ancient dress, each holding a large wooden cup of bitter drink and drinking from it, while a golden shaft of light shines from Mount Zion in the distance; dark storm clouds and a red dawn on the horizon, the cups spilling down onto the ground. Epic, solemn, not gory.
scenes.escapees_zion: Weary survivors climbing a stone path up to Mount Zion at sunrise: families with children and old people with bundles and staffs, some limping, reaching the holy mountain where a soft glow rests over the temple; the mountain ringed with light, olive trees on the slopes, a priest or elder at the top welcoming them with open hands; relief and thankfulness on their faces.
scenes.jacob_fire: A symbolic harvest-fire scene on the hills: a great bright fire of gold and orange sweeping across a field of dry yellow stubble, with the flames shaped like two reaching tongues (Jacob and Joseph) while the stubble (Esau) flattens and burns; in the distance a map-like panorama of returning exiles walking home over hills, the Negev desert, the Philistine coast and Gilead, with a small town named in the far horizon. Epic, warm colors, not gory.
scenes.kingdom_yahweh: A majestic vision above Mount Zion at dawn: a radiant empty golden throne seat of pure light high in the clouds (no figure shown) with a gentle rainbow-like halo, below it on the mountain several brave deliverers in plain tunics climbing up the slope toward the holy city, and across the valley the red mountains of Esau bathed in the first light; banners of white and gold, a quiet and solemn triumph. Awe-inspiring, hopeful.

jonah.setting: Setting: the eastern Mediterranean of the 8th century BC and the Assyrian city of Nineveh. The Joppa harbor with white limestone houses on a hillside, wooden merchant ships with square sails and carved prows, open deep-blue sea and storms; and inland Nineveh with vast sun-baked mudbrick walls, tall gates guarded by winged human-headed bull statues (lamassu), glazed blue tile and terracotta, the Tigris river, market streets, ziggurat-like temples. Palette that moves from stormy steel-blue, deep teal and foam-white (the sea) to warm terracotta, lapis blue and gold (Nineveh) and a scorching bleached-yellow noon (the east wind). Hebrew garments of undyed linen and wool with striped mantles; Assyrian dress of fringed, richly embroidered robes and bearded men with curled hair. Vivid and dramatic, never gory.

scenes.jonah: Jonah, a lean prophet in his thirties with a short dark beard and an exhausted, stunned face, crawling up onto a sandy beach at dawn, his wool robe soaked and a tangle of seaweed around his shoulders and head; behind him in the shallows the huge tail of a great fish slips under the waves; ahead of him a road winds inland toward the faint mudbrick towers of a great city shining in the early light. Dawn glow, relief and dread.
scenes.flight_tarshish: Joppa harbor at dawn: Jonah in a hooded traveler's cloak hurriedly counting coins into the hand of a ship's captain at the gangplank of a wooden merchant ship with a square sail, while casting a guilty glance back over his shoulder toward the east and the hills; sailors loading jars and bundles, white houses stacked up the hill behind, gulls wheeling, the open western sea bright on the horizon. Brisk and uneasy.
scenes.storm_at_sea: A wooden merchant ship battered by a huge storm: towering dark waves, a torn sail, lightning in a green-black sky; sailors in the foreground scrambling to throw cargo jars and bundles overboard, each praying differently, one kneeling with a small carved figure held up; a cutaway to the hold below deck where Jonah lies fast asleep on sacks and the ship master crouches shaking his shoulder to wake him. Cinematic, tense, not gory.
scenes.sailors: Dawn after the storm: a calm turquoise sea and a battered ship with a torn sail; sailors of different peoples kneel on the deck facing east with raised hands in awe and thanksgiving, a small makeshift altar of stones with a thin column of smoke rising and a lamb offering prepared, rope and oars scattered, gentle pink-gold light and relieved, humbled faces.
scenes.lots_confession: A tense scene on a ship's deck in a storm: a circle of sailors around a barrel with a bowl of casting lots (small marked sticks and stones), one lot lifted showing the pick; in the center Jonah stands with open hands, speaking calmly while pointing toward the sea and sky, and the sailors recoil in fear, wide-eyed, as the dark waves heave behind them.
scenes.great_fish: An underwater fantasy scene: a vast ancient great fish (whale-like, with a soft glowing eye) surging up through deep blue water with its enormous mouth open, about to swallow a tiny man in a wool robe tumbling downward trailing seaweed and bubbles; shafts of sunlight fall from the surface far above, shoals of small fish scatter, dark depths below. Awe-inspiring and slightly dreamlike, not gory, no blood.
scenes.jonah_psalm: Inside the belly of the great fish, imagined as a vast curved cavern with soft ribbed walls glowing a dim teal-green with floating plankton lights: Jonah kneels in prayer, hands raised, seaweed wrapped around his head, bubbles drifting up; far off through a gap in the curved walls shines a faint golden vision of the temple on a hill. Quiet, intimate and hopeful; not gory, no flesh details.
scenes.nineveh: The great city of Nineveh seen from its main gate: enormous mudbrick walls and towers, a gate flanked by huge winged human-headed bull statues, crowded market streets full of merchants and soldiers in fringed Assyrian robes, glazed blue tiles, a stepped temple tower in the distance and the Tigris sparkling beyond; small in the foreground Jonah in a plain wool robe stands at the gate looking up, dwarfed by the city. Epic scale, warm terracotta and lapis.
scenes.nineveh_repents: Nineveh in repentance: in a palace courtyard a bearded Assyrian king steps down from his throne, removing his royal robe, wrapped in sackcloth and sitting in ashes on the ground, nobles kneeling in rough sackcloth beside him; beyond the gate the streets are full of people of every age in dark sackcloth with bowed heads, even cattle and sheep wearing sackcloth cloths, a herald reading a decree from a scroll; soft gray-gold light after the gloom. Solemn and moving.
scenes.jonah_anger: Jonah on a hillside east of the city, angry and bitter, his fists clenched and his face dark and scowling as he looks up and complains toward the sky, robe whipped by wind and a small cloud of gloom around him alone; below him, bathed in gentle golden light, the great city of Nineveh stands intact and peaceful, smoke rising from hearths, people going about daily life. Sharp contrast between his storm and the city's calm.
scenes.plant_worm_wind: A harsh noon on a hill east of the city: a leafy vine that had shaded a small hand-built booth is now withered and brown, a small worm visible on the base of the stem; a blazing white sun overhead and a hot east wind blowing dust and dry leaves; Jonah slumps under the shriveled shade with a hand pressed to his head, exhausted and fainting, the distant city shimmering in heat haze. Bleached, scorching light.
scenes.gods_question: A quiet dusk view over Nineveh from a hillside: Jonah small and seen from behind, sitting alone on the slope looking down at the great city as its lamps and hearth fires begin to glow; in the lanes children play, flocks of sheep and cattle are led home, families gather on rooftops; above the city the clouds part in a soft shaft of golden light, no figure shown. Contemplative, open-ended and tender.

micah.setting: Setting: Judah in the late 8th century BC, from Micah's home village of Moresheth in the rolling lowland (Shephelah) of limestone hills, olive groves, fig trees, wheat fields and walled hill-towns, to Jerusalem with its temple on the mountain and Samaria on its hill to the north. Palette that moves between stormy judgment (iron gray, ash, dark violet, bruised red) and morning hope (dew-green, honey gold, soft sky blue). Garments of undyed linen and wool, indigo and madder-red striped mantles, sackcloth for mourning, richly embroidered robes and gold jewelry for the wealthy. Prophetic, earnest and cinematic; never gory.

scenes.micah: Micah, a rugged village prophet in his forties with a weathered face, graying dark beard and calloused hands, in a plain wool robe, standing on a stony hilltop above the farming village of Moresheth with terraced fields and olive trees; to one side far away on a hill stands Samaria under storm clouds, to the other Jerusalem with the temple catching sunlight; he raises one hand as he speaks, a small scroll in the other, urgent and compassionate.
scenes.lord_descends: A mighty vision of judgment: a tall column of blinding golden light and cloud descends from the sky onto the high places of the earth (no figure shown); mountains sag and melt like wax in a fire, valleys split and rivers of meltwater pour down steep slopes; far below on a ridge the city of Samaria with its idols and palace lies crumbling into rubble heaps and vineyard plots; tiny terrified people. Epic and awe-inspiring, not gory.
scenes.town_laments: A chain of small walled hill-towns of the Judean lowland at dusk (Gath, Lachish, Mareshah and others) strung along a dusty road; in the foreground Micah, barefoot in torn dark sackcloth, kneels and rolls his hands in dust and ashes, mourning and wailing with his head thrown back; townspeople watch from gates and rooftops, some turning away in shame, a cart harnessed to a fast horse leaving a gate. Mournful, dusty light.
scenes.land_grabbers: Two scenes in one: at the top left, wealthy men with embroidered robes lie awake on a luxurious bed at night scheming over a plan on a wax tablet; at dawn in the main scene they stride out with surveyors' cords and stakes to take a poor farmer's field and house, a widow with her small children being driven from their doorway clutching a bundle; boundary stones torn up. Tense, morally heavy, no gore.
scenes.rulers_butchers: A court gate of Jerusalem: a corrupt judge in fine robes accepting a bulging purse of silver from a wealthy man while ignoring a thin poor man pleading in rags; beside him a priest holding out a hand for payment before reading a scroll and a fortune-teller prophet counting coins; behind them the unfinished walls of Zion built with dark stained scaffolding; frightened commoners at the gate edge. Cold gold and shadow, tense, no gore.
scenes.paid_prophets: A banquet where sleek prophets in fine robes eat and drink, shouting 'Peace!' with open mouths and raised wine cups, a jar of wine on the table, while at the table's edge a hungry man is turned away; at the far side stands Micah alone, plain-robed, his eyes blazing, a soft glow of the Spirit around him as he points toward a darkening sky beyond the window. Strong contrast between the warm banquet and his cool clear light.
scenes.zion_field: A shocking vision of the future: the summit of the temple mount of Jerusalem plowed like a farm field: an ox team pulling a wooden plow over broken earth and tumbled limestone blocks, heaps of rubble, a wild tangle of thorn bushes where the temple once stood; in the far distance the small ruins of walls under a heavy gray sky; a lone farmer guides the plow. Desolate and solemn, not gory.
scenes.mountain_peace: A radiant vision of the last days: the mountain of Yahweh's house lifted high above all the hills, a gleaming temple city at its top bathed in golden light, streams of people from many nations in varied dress climbing the roads toward it joyfully; in the foreground a village forge where smiths hammer swords and spears into plowshares and pruning hooks, and families resting under their own vine and fig tree. Peaceful, luminous, hopeful.
scenes.zion_labor: A two-part scene: on the left, at the gate of Jerusalem at dusk, a procession of exiles with bundles leaves the city toward the open country, a pregnant woman leaning on a friend and clutching her side in pain, people looking back with grief; on the right in warm light a threshing floor where a great ox with an iron-tipped horn and bronze-sheathed hooves treads golden sheaves while the surrounding nations are gathered as sheaves, glittering tribute heaped aside. Tension between pain and promised victory.
scenes.bethlehem: A small humble stone village on a green hillside in Judea at dawn (Bethlehem Ephrathah), tiny among the hills; a strong gentle shepherd figure seen from behind stands on a ridge above it in a plain wool cloak holding a staff, looking out over a large flock of sheep resting safely; golden sunrise light spreads from the village across the hills toward the horizon, symbolizing greatness reaching the ends of the earth; a hint of ancient depth in the light. Quiet, reverent, awe-inspiring.
scenes.remnant_dew_lion: Symbolic scene: in the foreground a close view of grass beaded with dew in the early light; behind it a young lion standing alert on a rock above a flock of sheep in a green valley (the remnant among the nations); in the background people are tearing down war chariots, leading away war horses, uprooting carved idols and Asherah poles that burn in a heap, and dismantling a fortress wall. Hopeful, dramatic, not gory.
scenes.covenant_lawsuit: A courtroom of creation: a vast natural amphitheater of ancient mountains and hills seated like a jury around a valley, a luminous shaft of light from the sky where God's voice speaks (no figure); in the valley a small group of Israelites stands as defendants, elders and ordinary families looking up sheepishly; on the cloud horizon faint glowing memory scenes: Moses, Aaron and Miriam with a tambourine leading a crowd out of Egypt, and the Jordan crossing at Gilgal. Solemn and grand.
scenes.what_lord_requires: An earnest man in plain clothes has set down a pile of costly offerings on a stone altar (young calves, rams, jars of oil) and turns away from them to walk down a country road beside a poor old man, helping carry the old man's heavy bundle; scales of justice faintly carved on a milestone; a soft shaft of morning light on them; the walking pair is humble and quietly joyful. Warm gold and green, tender and clear.
scenes.false_scales: A bustling market at the city gate: a merchant with a wide smile and a fixed, tilted balance scale and a bag of unequal stone weights and a too-small grain measure cheating a worried poor buyer who holds an almost empty basket; in the background bare fields where the sowers reap nothing, an empty oil press and grape vat; on the far hill a grand palace in the style of Samaria, Omri and Ahab's house. Cool, accusing light.
scenes.no_one_upright: Micah alone in a stripped-bare vineyard after harvest at dusk, a hand on a bare vine hunting for an early fig and finding none, head bowed in lament; behind him the village where neighbors eye each other suspiciously from doorways, a son turning away from his angry father, a man hiding a net behind his back; gloomy amber-gray evening light. Lonely and sorrowful.
scenes.fallen_shall_rise: Night turning to dawn: Micah sits on the ground in darkness with a tired, hopeful face, a single small lamp beside him, his hand pushing up from the ground to rise; a thin line of dawn light breaks over the horizon behind him; in the shadows a few jeering enemy figures turn away shamed under the first light. Quiet faith and resilience.
scenes.god_like_you: A radiant dawn over a vast calm deep sea: on a rocky shore a remnant of people kneels or stands in awe, one man hurls a heavy dark bundle (their sins) far out into the water where it sinks into the bottomless blue depths; enormous golden light fills the sky with rays reaching down, no figure shown; sense of mercy, pardon and a promise kept to the fathers. Majestic, tender and luminous.

nahum.setting: Setting: the 7th century BC. Nineveh, capital of the Assyrian empire on the Tigris: colossal mud-brick walls with glazed-brick towers and monumental gates guarded by winged human-headed bull statues, a grand palace with carved stone relief panels, canals and river-gates, ziggurat temples, chariots, spearmen in scale armor and pointed helmets, scarlet shields. In contrast, the highlands of Judah with stony mountains, terraced hillsides and olive trees. Palette that moves between stormy judgment (iron gray, storm violet, ember orange, smoky red) and quiet relief (dawn gold, soft green, morning blue). Garments of linen, wool and fringed Assyrian robes, richly embroidered for the court. Dramatic, cinematic and solemn; never gory, no corpses shown.

scenes.nahum: Nahum, an Elkoshite prophet in his thirties with a lean earnest face and short dark beard, wearing a plain wool robe and headcloth, standing on a rocky hilltop in the highlands of Judah at dusk holding an unrolled scroll against the wind; far away on the horizon to the northeast, the great walled city of Nineveh glows under a gathering storm, lightning in the clouds above it; he looks toward it with solemn certainty, not hatred.
scenes.slow_to_anger: A towering storm vision of God's power (no figure shown): a colossal whirlwind and thunderhead, the clouds like dust kicked up by great feet, lightning splitting the sky; below, the sea pulled back and dry, river beds cracking, the forests of Bashan, Carmel and Lebanon wilting, mountains trembling and melting like wax, small terrified people shielding their eyes; a single calm break of golden light in the storm hints at patient restraint. Epic, awe-inspiring.
scenes.yahweh_good: A quiet refuge: a stout stone fortress-tower on a rock in the middle of a raging flood, its heavy gate open, and ordinary families, a shepherd and children hurrying in through it from rising dark water; a gentle hand of warm light on the door lintel (no figure); behind them the black flood engulfs a distant city on a plain. Contrast of terror outside and calm warm lamplight inside. Tender and protective.
scenes.nineveh_plot: A dark Assyrian council chamber at night: a scheming courtier in a tall pointed hat with a smooth sneer leans over a table of maps and clay tablets surrounded by generals and priests, plotting; a faint red storm glow at the window; outside through the window the city's torches and a rising black flood line far off; thorns and dry stubble in a bundle beside a brazier hint at being burned. Ominous, cunning, richly detailed.
scenes.yoke_broken: A stooped Judahite farmer and his wife on a hillside road, a heavy wooden yoke of rope and beams lying split in two on the ground at their feet, the cords burst apart, bound hands being unwound; far below, in the corner of a pagan temple, carved idol images lie toppled and broken. Hopeful relief on their faces as light breaks over the hills. Gentle, emotional, uplifting.
scenes.feet_on_mountains: A swift young messenger running barefoot along a high mountain ridge of Judah at sunrise, one hand raised and a rolled message in the other, his joyful face looking back toward the valley; villagers below on terraces lift their faces, a festival procession preparing with lambs and jars of wine for the feasts; golden sun rays and a flock of doves rising. Pure joy and good news, bright and luminous.
scenes.dasher: The siege of Nineveh: a vast army advancing under scarlet shields and red tunics, chariots with flashing steel fittings and pine-shafted spears raised, a mighty siege ramp piled against the great walls of the city; defenders on the ramparts frantically reinforcing the wall and gate; clouds of dust and smoke; viewpoint from behind the attackers. Dramatic, kinetic, cinematic, no gore.
scenes.river_gates: The collapse of Nineveh's river-gates: rushing floodwater breaks open the great water-gates and sluices of the city, surging through the courtyards and into the palace as colossal winged bull statues stand in the swirling water; the queen with her ladies, veiled and weeping, being led away by soldiers, beating their breasts; crowds of people fleeing in all directions while a single officer shouts and no one looks back; piles of silver and gold vessels glinting in the torrent. Tense, tragic, dramatic.
scenes.lions_den: A grand Assyrian palace hall with massive carved stone relief panels of lion hunts and conquests; in the center a lion and lioness with cubs lie on a heap of royal booty in a cavernous den-like hall, while the far end of the hall is already empty, cold, cracked and dark with only dust where the lions once were; a burning chariot and broken stone lions toppling in smoke. A shaft of divine light cuts through (no figure). Haunting, ironic, no gore.
scenes.bloody_city: A cracking-whip, thundering-chariot charge through the narrow streets of an Assyrian city: black war horses rearing, chariot wheels throwing sparks, riders with flashing swords and glittering spears, heavy smoke; on the walls, hanging banners and trophies of captured goods and chained captives marched away; a red sky; in the background a shadowy veiled woman figure draped in jewels holding a cup (the city's seductive pride) on a palace balcony, a shaft of stern light pinning her. Menacing and ominous, no bodies shown.
