scenes.no_amon: The great Egyptian city of No-Amon (Thebes) on the Nile: towering temple pylons and obelisks of Karnak behind canal moats of water, a wall rising from the river, the city in ruins after conquest; Assyrian soldiers marching long lines of tied captives away along the river shore, nobles and families among them; a distant statue toppled at the temple entrance; in the foreground a prophet's pointing hand (only the hand and sleeve) stretching in from the edge of the frame toward the ruins, as if saying 'you are no better'. Epic, somber, sunset gold.
scenes.fortress_figs: A fortress city under siege: its fortifications shown as fig trees laden with ripe figs that fall into the mouths of waiting soldiers when shaken; the gates of the land wide open and burning, the bars glowing in fire; on the walls terrified soldiers in armor shrinking back in fear, while behind them anxious workers hurriedly draw water and tread clay for bricks to repair the walls, hopelessly. A surreal mix of reality and symbolism. Dramatic and ironic.
scenes.locust_swarm: A vast swarm of locusts covering the stone walls and rooftops of Nineveh at a cold dawn, their wings gleaming; as the first sun appears they all rise at once and fly off in a roaring cloud, leaving bare walls; in the street below a crowd of merchants in rich robes, officials and generals stand stunned as their numbers vanish, gold and ledgers abandoned. Surreal, dramatic and symbolic.
scenes.no_healing: The final end of the Assyrian king: a heavyset Assyrian king in a tall tiara slumped on a tilted throne in an empty, half-ruined hall, his shepherds (court officials) asleep on the floor, nobles lying down, banners fallen; through the open walls his people scattered over the dark mountains like sheep with no shepherd; far away on the hills, small groups of different nations clap their hands in relief at the news. Mournful and heavy; a final grey-gold dawn light.

habakkuk.setting: Setting: Judah in the late 7th century BC, a troubled walled city of Jerusalem and its hill country with limestone ramparts, a lookout tower on the city wall, olive terraces, fig trees and vines; the rising Chaldean (Babylonian) army with swift horses, spearmen in pointed caps, earthen siege ramps and fishing-net imagery; and, for the prayer of chapter 3, the wild mountains and desert of Teman, Paran and Sinai with storm light. Palette moving from anxious dusk gray and ember red to dawn gold and deep teal. Garments of undyed wool and linen, indigo and madder-red stripes, fringed Chaldean tunics. Earnest, cinematic and solemn; never gory.

scenes.habakkuk: Habakkuk, a thoughtful prophet in his forties with a lined, sensitive face and short graying beard, in a plain wool robe and headcloth, standing alone on a stone watchtower on the city wall at dusk with an open scroll in one hand and the other raised to the sky as if arguing with heaven; behind him the lamps of Jerusalem and ahead a long dark horizon with a faint line of dust from a distant army; honest, searching, courageous.
scenes.how_long: Habakkuk crying out in the street of a troubled Jerusalem at evening: he stands with arms open and head thrown back in anguish while around him ordinary scenes of injustice play out: a merchant cheating a poor buyer, a judge turning away a widow's plea, a scuffle at the city gate, the scroll of the law lying neglected in the dust; a break of gold light in the clouds above, unanswered. Heavy, sorrowful, expressive.
scenes.chaldeans: The Chaldean cavalry sweeping across the plains at dusk: swift horses faster than leopards, riders in conical caps and fringed tunics galloping in a huge wave with an eagle-like swoop, long lines of tied captives behind them, an earthen siege ramp rising against a distant hill fortress; storm clouds and a red sunset. Terrifying, cinematic, no gore.
scenes.purer_eyes: Habakkuk in a quiet pre-dawn courtyard with a lamp, looking up in troubled prayer; in a vision above the rooftops a huge fisherman figure of the Chaldean king, seen from far away, drags a great net full of struggling tiny people from a dark sea and then bows down in worship before the net, burning incense to it on a small altar; sense of a prophet wrestling with God's justice. Symbolic, dramatic, no gore.
scenes.watch_post: Habakkuk standing at his watch post on a high rampart at sunrise, hands resting on the stone parapet, a scroll and a stone tablet beside him, scanning the horizon with patient attention; below, a messenger-like runner passing by reads a large plain-lettered tablet while running (no readable letters), warm golden dawn light on a quiet city; hope and waiting. Calm, still, luminous.
scenes.righteous_by_faith: An arrogant figure in rich robes with a puffed-up posture and a hollow chest strides past on one side, trailing a shadow, while on the other side a simple humble man in plain wool stands upright at the edge of a field holding a small lit oil lamp with both hands, steady and trusting under a vast sky; a single shaft of light falls on the lamp; thin contrast of pride and faith. Warm gold and deep blue, earnest and clear.
scenes.woes_plunder: A scene of the Chaldean conqueror's plunder and its reversal: a haughty drunken ruler with a wine cup heaps up loot (pledges, goods, tribute) around him on a pile; behind him a crowd of the nations he plundered, silhouetted, begin to rise up with torches and ropes; at the top he sets his nest on a high tower, and the stones of the wall in the foreground seem to cry out with carved mouths while the beam answers. Dramatic and morally tense.
scenes.sea_of_knowledge: A vast calm ocean covered with light: the surface of the sea glowing gold and teal in every direction, from the shore a great multitude of people of many nations standing and looking out in wonder, the whole earth glowing as if filled with knowledge of God's glory like water covering the sea; in the near foreground, a wooden half-built city wall of bloody bricks burns away into smoke while workers abandon their labor. Awe-inspiring and peaceful.
scenes.cup_of_wrath: An abusive host in rich robes pours a flagon of strong wine into the cup of a neighbor at a night banquet to shame him, then in the next moment a huge glowing golden cup is held out toward the host by a mighty hand of light (no body, just the hand) from the sky; the host recoils, his glory turning to shame, his forest of Lebanon cedar cut down and animals fleeing in the background. Strong moral reversal; modest, no nudity, no gore.
scenes.mute_idols: A craftsman's workshop: a sculptor kneeling in front of a freshly carved wooden idol overlaid with gold and silver, touching it and begging 'Awake!' while the idol sits mute and hollow, a gap showing no breath inside; beyond the workshop door, a quiet distant view of the temple on the mountain with soft light and a vast silence over the earth, people on rooftops bowing their heads in hush. Contrast of lifeless idol and living God. Quiet, solemn.
scenes.prayer_revive: Habakkuk kneeling in prayer in a stone room at night with open palms, a harp or stringed lyre beside him (a worship song), and on the wall behind him a faint glow of ancient deeds: the Red Sea parted, a pillar of fire over a camp, and Moses on Sinai; a thread of lamplight and dawn at the window as he asks God to 'make it known in our time'; reverent, intimate, hopeful.
scenes.from_teman: A vision of God coming in glory from Teman and Mount Paran: a rugged desert mountain range at dawn, blinding sunrise rays pouring from behind a peak and covering the heavens, beams of light coming from unseen hands, a plague-like dark mist and glowing embers following at the foot of the mountain (no figure shown); in the foreground the tents of Cushan and Midian trembling in the wind. Epic, awe-inspiring.
scenes.warrior_rides: A storm-vision of God as a warrior riding on the sea: mighty waves piling up and surging with the deep roaring and lifting up its hands, a bow of lightning and glittering spears of light flashing, the sun and moon standing still in the sky, mountains crumbling and ancient hills sinking, rivers splitting the earth, a rainbow-like arc of horses made of cloud and white spray trampling the sea; tiny people far below. Epic, dramatic, no figure shown.
scenes.yet_rejoice: A bare farm at the end of a failed harvest: a fig tree with no fruit, empty vines on a trellis, bare olive branches, a dry field and an empty sheepfold and cattle stall; yet in the middle Habakkuk, thin and tired but smiling, stands up on a rock with arms lifted toward a rising dawn, his feet like those of a deer leaping on a high rocky ridge behind him; golden light flooding the empty land. Joy in the midst of loss, luminous and moving.

zephaniah.setting: Setting: Jerusalem and Judah in the days of King Josiah (late 7th century BC): a crowded hill-city of limestone houses with flat roofs, the Fish Gate and the market district, the temple on its mountain, rooftop altars to sun, moon and stars, olive and fig terraces, the Mediterranean coast of Gaza and Ashkelon, the salt pits and nettles of Moab and Ammon, and the ruined palaces of Nineveh with pelicans and porcupines. Palette that moves between a looming day of wrath (iron gray, ember red, bruised violet, smoke black) and joyful restoration (dawn gold, soft green, clear morning blue). Garments of undyed linen and wool, indigo and madder-red stripes, richer foreign-styled clothing for the court. Earnest, cinematic, never gory.

scenes.zephaniah: Zephaniah, a dignified prophet in his forties with a well-kept dark beard, wearing a finer striped robe than a village prophet and a headcloth, standing on the roof terrace of a Jerusalem house at dawn holding an unrolled scroll, looking out over the city's rooftops with sober concern; the temple on its mountain behind him catches the light; storm clouds gather far on the horizon; steady, earnest and authoritative.
scenes.sweep_away: A cosmic vision of un-creation: a vast, slow sweeping wind of grey light rolling across the whole earth, sweeping up man and animals, birds of the sky and fish of the sea in swirling streams as if the order of creation were running backwards; piles of rubble stones heaped with the wicked among them; tiny silhouetted figures; a stern gold light from the sky (no figure shown). Epic, solemn, not gory.
scenes.mixed_worship: On a flat rooftop at dusk in Jerusalem, a row of worshippers burn incense to the stars and sun and moon on small altars, bowing toward the sky; in the same scene a man holds up his hand swearing an oath to Yahweh while another hand holds a small figure of the god Malcam behind his back; idolatrous priests in dark robes among them; in the distance the temple lamps burn quietly. Tense, ironic, richly detailed.
scenes.silent_before_lord: A hush before a sacrifice: a great stone altar in a courtyard with a ram prepared, and a line of guests in white robes (the consecrated guests) standing very still with fingers to their lips; around them, courtiers in foreign-styled embroidered clothing and men leaping over the threshold of a rich house clutching bags of plunder; heavy silent air, a dark sky and a thin line of light on the horizon. Ominous quiet.
scenes.search_lamps: Night in Jerusalem: a tall figure of light (no clear face, only a robed shape of radiance) walks through the narrow streets holding a bright lamp to search every house; complacent wealthy men sit comfortably beside wine jars full of settled dregs, shrugging at the light; one man in his courtyard building a house he will not live in, another planting a vineyard; the Fish Gate and the merchants' quarter beyond, with a cloth merchant weighing silver in the background. Tense, atmospheric, warm lamplight and shadow.
scenes.great_day: The great day of Yahweh: a vast black sky of dense clouds and gloom over Jerusalem's fortified towers, a trumpet blast shown as shock-rings in the air, the whole city in a hush of dread; tiny people on the walls and in the streets feeling their way like the blind, silver and gold coins and vessels scattered and useless on the ground, a fierce red-orange light like fire along the horizon. Dramatic, apocalyptic, no gore.
scenes.seek_humility: A hopeful gathering before the storm: ordinary humble people, farmers, shepherds, women with children and old men, coming together from the hills toward a small stone shelter in a cleft of rock at dusk while distant storm clouds approach; one old shepherd holds a lamp; they look up and seek; behind them on a rock the faint outline of a hand-carved word for 'hidden' (no letters). Gentle, urgent, hopeful warm light.
scenes.sea_coast: The Philistine sea coast: ruined walls and empty towers of Gaza and Ashkelon beside a bright blue sea, the streets overgrown with grass; the ruins slowly turning into green pastures with shepherds' huts and folds, a returning shepherd family of Judah leading their flock into the old houses at sunset, sheep lying down in the evening among the broken stones. Sad and then tender, golden evening light.
scenes.pride_moab: The salt-white wasteland that was Moab and Ammon: a desolate landscape of nettles, thorns and bright white salt pits and cracked pale earth under a hard sky, a ruined city gate half buried; in the foreground proud Moabite and Ammonite elders in rich robes mock a line of small distant Israelite families from a high wall, and the same wall is shown crumbling into salt and nettles beside them; in the sky, small idols shrinking and fading while ships from distant coastlands bring worshipers. Dramatic, symbolic.
scenes.ruined_nineveh: The ruins of proud Nineveh after its fall: great broken stone relief panels, toppled winged-bull statues, bare cedar beams laid open to the sky, herds of cattle and wild animals lying in the empty halls, a pelican and a porcupine sitting on the broken tops of columns, birds calling through empty window openings, thresholds in rubble, and a passerby shaking his fist and hissing as he walks past the mighty city that once said 'I am, and there is no one besides me.' Haunting, vast, dusty gold.
scenes.oppressing_city: A corrupt Jerusalem seen at dawn: the city's princes shown as roaring lions in robes and its judges as evening wolves at a court gate, tearing at a poor man's bundle; prophets in fine robes laughing and arrogant and a priest tampering with the temple vessels in the background; yet in the middle of the city a still pillar of morning light shines on the temple court, giving justice every morning. Dark and bright together, no gore.
scenes.pure_lips: A vision of the nations: people of many nations in different dress, tribes from beyond the rivers of Cush, standing shoulder to shoulder in a luminous procession, all calling on the name of Yahweh with open mouths and a soft clear light moving over their lips; one man carries an offering from far away, a woman from the dispersed people leads them; a silver stream of purifying light from above. Unity and renewal, bright and hopeful.
scenes.humble_remnant: A quiet village of the remnant: poor, plainly dressed families of the afflicted and lowly resting unafraid under fig trees and in a shaded olive grove, a shepherd feeding his flock beside them, children at play, no walls, no weapons; in the distance on the holy mountain the proud have gone and the temple stands in peace; soft green and gold, serene morning light. Gentle and trusting.
scenes.sing_over_you: A radiant, joyful scene: the daughter of Zion, a young woman in a flowing white-and-gold dress, arms raised, laughing and dancing on a hilltop in front of Jerusalem at sunrise as a great beam of golden light surrounds her; people of the city sing and shout with her; above, a luminous presence (no face, just radiant light in a loving embrace shape) rejoices over her with singing, music notes made of golden light drifting around. Jubilant and tender.
scenes.lame_gathered: A homecoming: a long line of those once driven away and shamed, the lame leaning on staffs, the weary, the old, returning along a road toward the gates of Jerusalem at golden dusk, being gathered and welcomed by joyful townspeople who carry a lame man on their shoulders and crown the returning with garlands; the shame of their past dissolving into honor and praise. Warm, tender, emotional.

haggai.setting: Setting: Jerusalem in 520 BC, in the early years after the return from Babylonian exile under Persian rule: a half-ruined hill-city of fallen limestone walls, charred stones and weeds, a bare temple platform with only a bare altar and scattered foundation stones on the mountain, newly built modest paneled homes of cedar, farmers in thin dry fields, stonecutters and carpenters, mule trains bringing timber down from the hills. Persian officials in fluted-crown style attire in the background. Palette that moves between dry drought (dust ochre, pale gray, faded blue) and renewal (fresh green, bright morning gold, warm clay and cedar red). Garments of linen and wool, indigo and madder-red stripes; priests in white linen. Earnest, hopeful, never gory.

scenes.haggai: Haggai, an elderly prophet with a lined weathered face, white-gray beard and a firm voice, wearing a plain wool robe and a headcloth, standing on the stone foundation of the ruined temple platform in Jerusalem at morning, one arm lifted as he addresses a crowd of returned exiles gathered below on the rubble, a few stone blocks and bare ground behind him; lean, urgent, plain-spoken prophet; warm morning light.
scenes.zerubbabel: Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, a calm dignified man in his forties with a trimmed dark beard, wearing a Persian-style governor's embroidered robe and a small circlet, standing in the temple rubble with a builder's plumb line and a foundation stone in his hand beside workers; the gold signet ring on his finger glinting in the light; Persian banner small in the distance; resolute and hopeful.
scenes.joshua_high_priest: Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, a dignified older man in white linen priestly robes, an embroidered ephod, a blue-and-gold turban, standing at the rough stone altar in the temple ruins, hands raised in blessing over workers kneeling around him, a faint smoke of sacrifice rising; solemn, calm and warm light.
scenes.paneled_houses: A tidy neighborhood of newly built cedar-paneled houses with carved wooden ceilings and gleaming lamps, a family sitting comfortably indoors at a warm meal, while through the open doorway across the valley the bare temple mountain stands in ruins and weeds, only a few scattered stones; a stern shaft of light falls on the ruins; the contrast of private comfort and neglected house of God. Gentle irony, warm and cold light.
scenes.consider_ways: A farmer in thin worn clothes looking at his hands and at a bag full of holes from which coins spill onto dry ground; a dry cracked field with thin grain, an empty wine vat, a half-empty bread basket, a woman shivering in thin clothes beside a smoky fire; bare hills behind and no dew on the plants, a cloud of dust blowing; mood of reflection and weary emptiness; ochre and gray, with a thin line of hopeful light.
scenes.i_am_with_you: The people respond: returned exiles of all ages, the governor, the high priest and ordinary families, carrying beams, stones and tools, climbing the forested hill to cut cedar timber and hauling it down on carts toward the temple site, a warm glow of light surrounding them as if a hand gently stirs their hearts; children and old men work together; a messenger-prophet in the foreground smiling. Energetic, joyful, golden morning light.
scenes.former_glory: Old men who remember the first temple, with white beards and shaking hands, standing beside the new modest stone foundation of the second temple, some weeping and some looking up in hope as young builders work beside them; a faint ghostly golden outline of Solomon's grand temple floats like memory in the air above the humble foundation; Zerubbabel's steady hand on one old man's shoulder encouraging him. Poignant, tender, hopeful.
scenes.shake_nations: A vision of the shaking of all things: the heavens, sea, earth and dry land trembling, ocean waves rising, mountains shaking, thrones and crowns of kingdoms tumbling at the edges; from every direction streams of people from many nations bring gold, silver, treasures and gifts in procession toward a humble temple that fills with a golden glory, the whole house glowing; solemn, awesome yet bright.
scenes.holy_unclean: A teaching scene in the temple court: Haggai stands before two priests in white linen who answer his questions with calm gestures; on a table before them demonstration items: a piece of holy meat in the fold of a garment touching bread, stew, wine and oil, and a separate piece of cloth with a faint grey cloud of uncleanness from a corpse touching food; a faint shade shows contamination spreading while holiness does not. Calm, instructive, solemn.
scenes.from_today_bless: Turning point at dawn: a farmer stands at the edge of the barren field planting the first seed, his family kneeling beside him, an empty granary behind and bare vine, fig, pomegranate and olive trees just starting to bud with a blush of green at their tips; a stone laid in the temple foundation glows in the background; rain-bearing clouds on the horizon and golden light promising blessing. Hope, humble beginnings.
scenes.signet_ring: A vision of Yahweh's promise: a great luminous hand of light from the sky holding a signet ring and pressing it with a seal into soft glowing wax over a rubble of toppled thrones, crowns, chariots and fallen horses of the kingdoms; in the foreground a small figure, Zerubbabel, in plain governor's robes kneeling calmly with his hand on his chest, chosen; shaking earth behind. Majestic, solemn, tender.

zechariah.setting: Setting: Jerusalem and Judah in 520-518 BC in the early years after the Babylonian exile under Persian rule: a half-rebuilt hill-city of limestone and mud-brick houses, a modest temple under construction on the mountain, the Mount of Olives to the east, myrtle groves in a hollow, bronze mountains, wooden measuring lines, olive trees and vines; and for the night visions a dreamlike symbolic realm. Palette that shifts between deep night blue and violet (night visions), burnished gold and olive green (hope), and stormy ash gray and crimson (judgment). Garments of undyed linen and wool, indigo and madder-red stripes, white priestly linen and bright festival robes. Symbolic, luminous and cinematic; never gory.

scenes.zechariah: Zechariah, a thoughtful young prophet (late 20s) with dark hair and a short beard, wearing a plain wool robe with an indigo-striped mantle, sitting on a stone ledge on the temple mountain at night with an open scroll on his knees, looking up with wide wonder at a faint glow in the sky; Jerusalem's lamps below and stars above; behind him the half-built temple scaffolding. Wonder, receptive and gentle.
scenes.return_to_me: A courtyard at dawn where returned exiles of different ages stand reading old scrolls of the earlier prophets; an elderly man points at a stone pillar worn with age while a young man turns to face the sunrise and opens his hands; the old prophets' shadows fade into light on the wall behind them, as if the words 'turn to me and I will turn to you' were warmly answering; a path of light curving toward the temple mountain. Reflective, warm and hopeful.
scenes.night_visions: A night vision of a hollow of myrtle trees under a deep blue sky: a rider on a red horse stands among the myrtles with red, chestnut and white horses behind him, riders on patrol across the whole earth, an angel of Yahweh beside them; on the horizon floating in the sky, four great horns of animals and four craftsmen with hammers approaching to cast them down. Dreamlike, luminous night, symbolic and rich.
scenes.wall_of_fire: A young man with a measuring line in his hand walks toward Jerusalem at night to measure the city, and an angel stops him to say the city will have no walls; Jerusalem sprawls open like a village without walls full of people and livestock, yet around it a vast wall of golden fire glows protectively in the dark and a radiant glory fills the center. Awe, comfort and security.
scenes.apple_of_eye: A returning crowd of exiles hurrying out of a gloomy Babylonian-style city at dawn toward Zion; above them a great luminous eye of golden light, tender and watchful (a gentle iris, no menacing look), centered over the people like a protective apple of the eye; a hand of light touching a pupil guarded by lashes of rays; ahead on a hill Jerusalem greets them with light and singing. Tender, protective, bright.
scenes.joshua_clothes: Joshua the high priest in filthy, stained clothes standing before the angel of Yahweh, a tall radiant figure; at his right a dark shadowy accuser figure (Satan) points a long finger; the angel raises a calm hand and the filthy garments fall away as attendants lift a clean white robe and a clean turban onto him; a brand plucked from a fire smoldering on a stone beside them. Dramatic, tender, luminous.
scenes.the_branch: A vision of promise: a young green shoot (the Branch) rising from an old cut tree stump in front of a stone; a great engraved stone with seven bright eyes of light set before Joshua the high priest and his colleagues; the scene fades into a peaceful village where neighbors invite one another to sit under their vine and fig tree on a golden day. Hopeful, quiet, luminous.
scenes.by_my_spirit: A giant pure-gold lampstand with a golden bowl on top and seven lamps with seven spouts each, standing in the night; on each side an olive tree streaming golden oil through two golden pipes into the bowl; in the foreground Zerubbabel, a governor with a plumb line in hand, looks at a great mountain turning flat like a plain before him as workers bring out the capstone with shouts of joy, a gentle wind of light (the Spirit) moving over everything. Awe, hope, quiet power.
scenes.scroll_and_basket: Two night visions together: on the left, an enormous flying scroll twenty cubits by ten (no readable letters) sailing through the dark sky and entering a thief's house and a liar's house, turning their wood and stone to dust; on the right, a large measuring basket (ephah) with a heavy round lead cover, in which a veiled figure sits (wickedness), carried off between heaven and earth by two winged women with stork wings toward a distant land of Shinar where a house waits. Weird, solemn, symbolic.
scenes.four_chariots: Four war chariots driving out between two huge bronze mountains: the first with red horses, the second with black, the third with white, the fourth with dappled strong horses, streaming out like the four winds of heaven toward the four directions of the earth, dust and wind trailing behind; a messenger angel watching from a rock. Dramatic, symbolic, majestic.
scenes.crowned_branch: A silversmith's workshop where silver and gold brought by exiles from Babylon are melted and shaped into crowns; Joshua the high priest in white linen bows his head as a crown is placed on it; behind him, a glowing man called the Branch is sketched in light as rising and building a temple, sitting on a throne and ruling as priest, in harmony between the two offices; far-off people coming to help build. Warm, solemn, symbolic.
scenes.fasting_question: A delegation from Bethel enters the temple court to ask the priests whether they should keep their fast of the fifth month; the priests listen while a prophet answers calmly; to the side in a lamplit vision, a woman widow, an orphan child and a foreigner and a poor man stand patiently while a rich man looks away with hardened heart (a stone-like heart, ears blocked, turned shoulder). Contrast of empty fasting and real mercy. Gentle, serious.
scenes.old_men_children: A joyful vision of Jerusalem's streets: old men and old women sitting on benches in the sunlit street, each leaning on a staff, smiling and chatting, while boys and girls play and run around them in the city squares; a calm walled city of truth with the holy mountain behind, golden light, a balanced harmony of ages. Warm, domestic, lovely.
scenes.fasts_to_feasts: A procession of ten men of different nations, in different clothing, taking hold of a Judean man's robe hem and walking with him, saying 'let us go with you'; behind them, grim fasting days turn to bright feast days: black mourning cloth becoming festival banners and wine, tables laid with bread; gates where people speak truth and judge peacefully. Festive, warm, welcoming.
scenes.humble_king: A gentle king riding a small donkey (the foal of a donkey) into Jerusalem through crowds who sing and wave palm and olive branches and spread cloaks on the road; war chariots and bows lie broken at the roadside, a white dove above; the king (shown calmly from the side, humble, in plain robes, with a soft gold halo of light behind him) rides with peace; sunlit hills, joyful faces, prisoners freed from a dry pit nearby. Peaceful, triumphant, tender.
scenes.scattered_flock: A hilltop where a flock of sheep wander scattered without a shepherd under a gray sky, shepherd's staffs fallen, fortune-tellers and household idols with false dreams being blown away like leaves; then dawn light and a Good Shepherd's hand (a gentle presence) gathering the flock, whistling them back with a high clear call; the sheep turn into war horses in battle array (strength restored); the scattered gather from Egypt and Assyria. Hope after neglect, warm and bright.
scenes.two_staffs: A shepherd (the prophet) tending a flock marked for slaughter, holding two staffs, one called Favor (Beauty) and one called Union, in a broken pasture where cedars of Lebanon have fallen; in the next moment he breaks the first staff in two before a crowd of dealers; thirty silver coins weighed on a scale and thrown into the temple treasury for the potter, a potter at his wheel in the corner of the temple court; a foolish shepherd's gear left on a table. Solemn, symbolic, heavy.
scenes.heavy_stone: Jerusalem as a huge immovable stone on a mountain, surrounded by armies of nations that strain to lift it and are wounded; their horses blind and wild with panic, riders dazed; around the stone a cup of reeling stands on a rock, fiery torches of Judah's clan chiefs blazing among bundles of sheaves like fire in wood; the city stands safe with the weakest as strong as David. Epic, symbolic.
scenes.pierced_one: A great quiet mourning in Jerusalem: families sitting apart in grief, the men on one side and the women on the other, house after house (the house of David, the house of Nathan, the house of Levi, the house of Shimei) in separate small circles; above them a gentle radiant Spirit of grace pouring down like soft light and tears; a distant glimpse of a figure, pierced and looked upon, shown only as a gentle silhouette of light. Deep grief and mercy, tender and solemn.
scenes.fountain_cleansing: A pure spring of clear water breaking out of the ground in Jerusalem's courtyard, flowing with silver-bright water that washes the people of David's house and the inhabitants of the city; idols carved on the ground fade away and false prophets in hairy cloaks take them off in shame and turn into farmers; a man with scars on his arms says he is a farmer. Cleansing, hopeful, bright.
scenes.struck_shepherd: A lonely shepherd in a plain robe lying struck down on the ground under a dark sky with a drawn sword above, the sheep scattering over the hills in all directions; then in the foreground a smaller group of survivors passes through a furnace of refining fire like silver and gold being purified, calling on the name of Yahweh and answered: 'They are my people.' Dramatic, sorrowful and hopeful.
scenes.mount_of_olives: The Mount of Olives splitting in two from east to west into a great valley, half the mountain moving north and half south, as people flee through the valley; a glorious, luminous presence (no face, just radiant light) with all his holy ones descends on the mount, with a gleaming Jerusalem in the background at dusk as the earth shakes (like the earthquake of Uzziah's days). Epic, awe-inspiring.
scenes.living_water: A shining river of living water flowing out of Jerusalem in two streams, one east toward the eastern sea and the other west toward the western sea, in summer and winter alike, with land turned flat like the Arabah around the city and people living safely, no curse; light that is neither day nor night, glowing at evening time; above the whole earth a single golden crown-like sign of the one King. Peaceful, golden-blue, luminous.
scenes.holy_to_yahweh: Nations coming up to Jerusalem every year to celebrate the Feast of Booths in leafy shelters on the slopes, flags and branches everywhere; at the temple, horses' bells and ordinary cooking pots and bowls, even common kitchen pots, are shown glowing with a gentle holy light and inscribed with a carved sign (no readable letters); ordinary people cooking joyfully in sacred bowls; joyful, communal and festive.

malachi.setting: Setting: Jerusalem in the fifth century BC, under Persian rule, some decades after the second temple was rebuilt: a modest rebuilt temple on the mountain with its stone altar and courtyard, tired priests in white linen, a provincial governor's court with Persian banners, lambs and rams for offerings, grain storehouses, a goldsmith's refining furnace and a fuller's washing pool, vineyards and wheat fields, the desert hills of Edom to the southeast. Palette that moves between weary dusty gray-gold (a dull routine) and the bright dawn of healing (warm gold, clear sunrise orange, clean white). Garments of undyed linen and wool, indigo and madder-red stripes, white priestly linen. Earnest, quiet and luminous; never gory.

scenes.malachi: Malachi, a plain-spoken prophet in his forties with a calm direct gaze, a short dark beard and a modest wool robe, standing in the temple courtyard at dusk with an unrolled scroll, one hand raised, speaking to a few tired priests and townspeople in a gentle but firm dialogue; the altar smoke and temple stone behind him; a faint golden dawn line on the eastern horizon; honest, patient, steady.
scenes.loved_jacob: A tender and pointed scene: a father-like warm presence (shown only as a soft gold glow over the temple mountain) looks over a weary family of returned Israelites who shrug at the sky asking 'how have you loved us?'; in the far background the rocky red ruins of Edom's mountains stand desolate with wild jackals; two twin silhouettes of Jacob and Esau as children in the sky as memory; golden dawn light on Jacob's side, grey dust on the Edom side. Poignant, symbolic.
scenes.father_master: In the temple court a priest with a bored, careless air offers a sickly lamb, blind in one eye and limping, to the altar while a plain-clothed worshiper looks on; to the side a servant respectfully bows to his master and a young son honors his father, contrasting the priests' neglect; the offerings table with fine bread and wine neglected; Persian governor in the background, in a rich robe, refusing to accept the same poor gift. Quietly accusing, warm gold and gray.
scenes.name_great_nations: A panoramic vision from sunrise to sunset: from the east to the west, across mountains, deserts, seas and cities, in village after village people of many nations in varied dress offer incense and pure offerings at small altars as smoke rises into the golden sky; at the center in the foreground a priest quietly shuts the temple door on an empty, lifeless offering fire. Wide, luminous and hopeful; a great name glowing over the world (no text).
scenes.levi_covenant: An ideal priest of Levi in white linen and a blue-and-gold sash, standing in the temple court with calm dignity as people gather around to ask him for instruction; his mouth open as if teaching the law, a scroll in his hand, with a soft glowing ring-like 'covenant of life and peace' light around him; behind him a corrupt priest turns away, and people stumble. Reverent, instructive, warm.
scenes.one_father: A family at the temple: a man sits on a stone bench with his lifelong wife, the wife of his youth, her head veiled and eyes sad with tears falling onto the altar below; he turns his face away toward a foreign woman at the temple door; around them neighbors with different expressions of unease; a soft glow of the one Creator above all, one father over all, with godly offspring children in the background. Quiet, tender, heavy.
scenes.messenger_before_me: A weary crowd in the temple court complains with raised hands, 'where is the God of justice?', while at the edge of the road a plain messenger in camel hair robe, shown from behind running ahead along a desert road, prepares the way with a pick and a rope, clearing stones; the temple gate at the end of the road starts to glow as if someone great is about to come suddenly into his temple, light pouring from the doors. Anticipation, awe, quiet urgency.
scenes.refiners_fire: A silversmith's workshop: a refiner sitting by a roaring furnace with a crucible of molten silver and gold, watching it carefully and skimming the dross, and a fuller's pool of soap and lye nearby; in the molten metal a clear reflection of a priest's face growing clearer; white-robed Levites standing in a line to be refined; then in the background the temple offerings in joyful order as in ancient days. Warm fire light, hopeful, intense.
scenes.tithe_test: A temple storehouse overflowing: farmers bring baskets of grain, jars of wine and oil, bundles of wheat and firstfruits through a stone doorway into a vaulted storehouse until it is full; above the roof the windows of heaven open and a flood of golden blessing and rain pours down on neat vineyards and wheat fields; locust-like devourers held back by a gentle hand of light at the field's edge; nations in the distance calling them happy. Abundance, warm light.
scenes.remembrance_scroll: A quiet gathering at dusk: a small group of God-fearing people sits on a hillside talking together in low voices, their faces lit by a lamp; above them the sky opens slightly and a great book of remembrance lies open in the clouds, the names being written in golden light (no readable letters), a gentle listening presence shown as a soft glow bending toward them; in the background arrogant prosperous people feast but fade. Intimate, tender, hopeful.
scenes.sun_of_righteousness: A glorious dawn: the sun of righteousness rising with healing in its wings, a huge sun disk with outstretched wings of golden light across the whole sky, warm rays reaching down over a valley; joyful people running out of their barns and leaping like calves released from the stall, children and animals in the grass; behind them a dark smoking furnace of stubble burns itself out in the distance. Radiant, joyful, healing.
scenes.elijah_hearts: A hilltop at sunrise: the prophet Elijah, a rugged ancient man in a hairy mantle and leather belt with a staff, shown in dawn silhouette standing on a ridge as if sent ahead, while below him fathers and their children turn toward one another on a hillside, embracing and reconciling; an old scroll of Moses' law resting on a stone, the great day looming as light behind clouds; the whole scene bathed in warm hope. Gentle, solemn, hopeful.

matthew.setting: Setting: Roman-ruled Judea and Galilee in the early first century AD: whitewashed limestone villages with flat roofs and outdoor staircases, the Sea of Galilee with fishing boats and nets, rolling green hills and wheat fields, olive and fig trees, the Jordan river, a wilderness of pale rock, the stone-paved streets and temple of Jerusalem with Herod's grand portico, Roman soldiers in red cloaks and iron helmets, tax booths, wells and market stalls, oil lamps. Jesus is always shown with respect: a first-century Middle Eastern Jewish man in a simple undyed linen tunic and a plain cloak with tassels, with a gentle, serene, humble bearing, often seen from the side or behind, never a realistic close-up portrait, with a soft warm halo of light, not Western-medieval. Other people in linen and wool robes with indigo and madder-red stripes. Palette moves between warm golden Galilee mornings and deep blue night; sorrow scenes use stormy gray, dignified and never gory, no visible wounds or blood. Reverent, cinematic, tender.

scenes.jesus: Jesus of Nazareth, a first-century Galilean Jewish man in his thirties in a simple undyed linen tunic and cloak with tassels, with dark hair and a short beard, standing on a grassy hillside above the Sea of Galilee at golden sunrise, one hand lifted in teaching or blessing, gentle, serene and authoritative; seen mostly from the side with soft light around him, a crowd of ordinary people below listening; reverent, warm, not a stiff portrait.
scenes.genealogy: A great luminous family tree rising out of a scroll: a line of figures from Abraham, with Isaac, Jacob, Judah, then King David with a harp and Solomon, down through exiles to Joseph, and at the top a small cradle of light; four women stand out along the tree: Tamar, Rahab with a scarlet cord, Ruth with sheaves, and Bathsheba, each in her own warm color; a gold-lit ancient manuscript style, rich and symbolic, no readable letters.
scenes.joseph_nazareth: Joseph, a quiet carpenter of Nazareth in his twenties with a short beard and sawdust on his hands, asleep on a simple bed with his head on his arm, an angel of the Lord in soft white-gold light bending toward him in a dream (no clear face), a carpenter's tools and wood shavings on the floor, a night lamp, and in the next panel he leads a donkey with Mary and a small child on a desert road toward Egypt under stars; tender and protective.
scenes.mary_virgin: Mary, a young Jewish woman of Nazareth in a blue-and-cream veil and tunic, sitting with a calm, wondering face and a hand on her womb in a lamplit courtyard; a soft golden glow gently surrounding her, a distant angelic light at the doorway and a quiet Nazareth night; later in the same image a small manger glimpsed in the background; humble, serene, modest.
scenes.magi: The Magi from the East: three dignified scholar-astronomers in layered Persian robes and tall caps kneeling in a simple Bethlehem house doorway offering gold, frankincense and myrrh in decorative boxes to a mother and small child shown softly lit (the child's face not detailed); a bright star above the roof through the window; camels waiting outside in the night; wonder and reverence.
scenes.herod_great: King Herod the Great, an aging, suspicious king with a gray beard and a gold circlet, in his palace of white stone and marble on a balcony at night with a lamp, summoning chief priests and scribes who unroll scrolls; his shadow looms large on the wall behind him; a thin star glimmers over the far town of Bethlehem; dark, tense, no violence shown.
scenes.john_baptist: John the Baptist, a lean, sun-browned prophet in a camel-hair garment with a leather belt, wild long hair and beard, standing waist-deep in the Jordan river preaching with one arm raised to a crowd of ordinary people and Pharisees on the banks, a bowl of locusts and wild honey on a rock; sparkling water and desert cliffs; earnest, fiery and humble.
scenes.baptism_of_jesus: Jesus entering the Jordan river to be baptized by John, shown from behind with his head slightly bowed, the heavens opening above with a great shaft of golden light and a white dove descending toward him; John in camel hair reverently pouring water; reeds and sparkling river; a cloud of radiance but no clear face of God; awe, peace and humility.
scenes.temptation_wilderness: Jesus alone in a stony desert wilderness at dusk, thin and quiet in a plain robe, standing firm with an open scroll as a shadowy tempter figure (a tall dark robed figure with a faint ember glow) offers stones turned to bread, a view of a high temple pinnacle and a mountain showing kingdoms of the world below; three small vignettes of the three tests; angels waiting at a distance in soft light; stark and calm.
scenes.fishers_of_men: Four Galilean fishermen: Peter and Andrew casting a net from a boat, James and John mending nets with their father Zebedee, on the Sea of Galilee at sunrise as Jesus (seen from the side) walks on the shore and calls them with a gesture; Peter and Andrew leaving their nets with wonder on their faces; golden light, shining water, boats and hills.
scenes.beatitudes: The Sermon on the Mount: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) seated on a grassy hillside above the Sea of Galilee teaching, with disciples near him and a large crowd of the poor, the weeping, the sick, children, peacemakers and mothers spread across the slope; wildflowers, a gentle breeze; warm gold morning light; peace and invitation.
scenes.salt_and_light: A hilltop village of whitewashed houses glowing at dusk like a city on a hill that cannot be hidden, an oil lamp on a lampstand lighting a whole house with a family inside, and in the foreground a woman seasoning bread with a pinch of salt from a clay jar; the lamp-light spreads in golden rings; warm, homely and bright.
scenes.lords_prayer: A quiet private room: a person kneeling in prayer with closed eyes and open hands, the door shut, the sky outside visible through a small window with an open sunlit heaven and a soft shaft of light (no figure); a loaf of bread on a table, a forgiven debt tablet torn in two; in the background, hypocrites praying loudly on a street corner fade away; calm, intimate, warm.
scenes.birds_and_lilies: A hillside meadow full of wild lilies and red anemones in spring with birds flying overhead and settling on a branch, a worried mother and father looking at a sparse pantry shelf but turning to look at the flowers and the sky in a moment of peace; the sunlight like a gentle hand over them; cheerful and consoling.
scenes.two_builders: Two houses side by side: a wise builder's house on a great rock standing firm in a storm with rain, rising river and wind, and a foolish man's house on sand collapsing; people with open faces looking at both; a narrow gate with a few people entering and a broad road with many people nearby; dramatic and clear, no gore.
scenes.centurion_faith: A Roman centurion in a red cloak and crested helmet standing humbly before Jesus (seen from the side) in a Capernaum street, his hand over his heart, speaking with trust that a word alone is enough; behind him a young servant lies sick on a bed through an open doorway, soldiers waiting; the crowd marvels; warm morning light.
scenes.matthew_tax_collector: Matthew (Levi), a tax collector at his booth in Capernaum with an abacus, a scale and coin bags on a table, looking up with surprise as Jesus (seen from the side) stands before him and says 'follow me'; Matthew half rising and leaving the coins on the table; neighbors scowl at tax collectors; afterwards a dinner scene with tax collectors and sinners eating with Jesus while Pharisees watch from outside; warm, human, slightly humorous.
scenes.twelve_sent: Twelve disciples of different ages and backgrounds in simple travel robes with staffs and sandals, standing on a village road at the start of a mission as Jesus (seen from behind) sends them out two by two with a gesture; a wide harvest field full of ripe wheat and a few workers behind them, a sign of wolves and sheep, hopeful and daring.
scenes.come_to_me: A tired farmer carrying a heavy wooden yoke and a load of firewood on a dusty road, stopping to look up as Jesus (seen from the side) offers him a hand; a double yoke shown, easy and light, with a pair of oxen in the background; soft evening light; weary people from village alley lines following; consoling, warm.
scenes.sign_of_jonah: Pharisees and scribes crowd around Jesus demanding a sign; in the sky behind him is a luminous vision of the great fish and Jonah, and the people of Nineveh in sackcloth kneeling, as well as the queen of the South arriving from far away to hear wisdom; a quiet tomb-like cave in the hillside in the corner; stern and thoughtful.
scenes.sower_parable: A sower scattering seed over a field, with seed falling on a path (birds eating it), on rocky ground (quick sprouts withering in the sun), among thorns (choked) and on good soil (thick golden grain, thirty, sixty, a hundredfold); Jesus teaching from a boat just off the shore to a crowd seated on the beach; warm morning light, rich colors.
scenes.treasure_and_pearl: A farmer joyfully digging a hidden treasure chest in a field and a merchant at the seashore selling everything to buy one great pearl; in the background, fishermen sorting a full net into good and bad fish, and a mustard seed becoming a tree full of birds beside a woman kneading yeast into dough; bright, storybook-like, warm.
scenes.walking_on_water: A boat tossed in a night storm on the Sea of Galilee with disciples afraid; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) walking calmly on the waves toward them, and Peter, a sturdy fisherman, stepping out of the boat onto the water with a hand reaching out and then sinking, caught by Jesus' hand; wind, spray and a break of moonlight; tension then wonder.
scenes.canaanite_woman: A Canaanite mother in Tyre-style clothing kneeling on a dusty road, calling out to Jesus (seen from the side) while disciples try to send her away, her eyes full of persistence and love; a dog and scattered crumbs near a table, a sick daughter shown as a faint glow in a house far behind; gentle tension and tender resolution.
scenes.simon_peter: Simon Peter, a broad-shouldered Galilean fisherman in his forties with a short curly beard, standing on a rocky hillside at Caesarea Philippi with Jesus (seen from the side) next to him and the other disciples listening; a great spring cave and a cliff of rock behind them, a pair of heavy keys of light glimmering in the air; bright, serious, heartfelt.
scenes.transfiguration: Jesus transfigured on a high mountain: a figure in dazzling white garments shining like the sun (face softly veiled in light), Moses and Elijah talking with him on either side, and below Peter, James and John fallen on their faces in awe with a bright cloud overshadowing them and a beam of light from heaven; stunning, luminous, reverent.
scenes.unforgiving_servant: A king in a rich hall canceling a huge debt (stacks of sacks of gold coins) of a kneeling servant who is then seen outside choking a fellow servant over a tiny debt of a few coins; the king's other servants watching with alarm; contrast of generosity and harshness; warm and cold light, parable-style.
scenes.vineyard_workers: A landowner in a vineyard at dusk paying the workers their wages at a long table: the early workers with sun-weathered faces grumbling at the last-hired workers who also receive the same silver coin, while the landowner gently explains; grape vines, baskets, an evening sky with rose and gold; warm parable-style.
scenes.palm_sunday: Jesus riding into Jerusalem on a donkey, seen from the side with a calm bearing and soft light, crowds spreading cloaks and palm branches on the road, children shouting; the golden gate and temple walls in the background; a foal of the donkey beside; joyful, festive, humble.
scenes.great_commandment: Jesus (seen from the side) in the temple court answering a scholar of the law, with two glowing tablets or two great beams of light written as hearts, one reaching up to heaven and the other toward a neighbor; Pharisees and Sadducees listening with arms folded; a coin with Caesar's face lying on a table from an earlier question; clear, calm.
scenes.woes_pharisees: Pharisees and scribes in wide, ornate prayer robes with long tassels and big phylacteries striding through the temple court, showy and proud, with a plate that is clean outside but dirty inside, whitewashed tombs gleaming white outside near them; Jesus (seen from the side) stands in sorrow before them with open hands, grief more than anger; sober, richly detailed.
scenes.ten_virgins: Ten young women with lamps at night outside a wedding house: five wise ones with extra jars of oil enter the brightly lit door, while five foolish ones with burnt-out lamps stand outside in the dark; a bridegroom's procession with torches arriving at midnight; a closed door; atmospheric night, tense.
scenes.talents: A master going on a journey handing bags of gold to three servants: one rejoicing with five, one with two, one burying his single bag in the ground; the master returns and the first two present doubled sums while the third nervously unearths his bag; warm lamplit hall, parable-style.
scenes.sheep_and_goats: The king on a throne of light (face not shown) sitting in glory with angels, nations gathered before him separating like a shepherd divides sheep and goats: sheep on his right shown with the faces of those who fed the hungry, gave drink, welcomed strangers, clothed the naked, visited the sick and prisoners (small vignettes), goats on the left in shadow; majestic, solemn, tender.
scenes.last_supper: The Passover meal in an upstairs room: Jesus (seen from the side) seated at a low table with the twelve disciples reclining around him, breaking a flatbread and holding a cup, oil lamps glowing, a sense of awe and sorrow on their faces; Judas near the table's edge in shadow; an open window with evening light; intimate, warm, reverent.
scenes.gethsemane: Jesus kneeling in prayer in a dark olive grove in Gethsemane at night, shown from the side or behind with bowed head and open hands on a large rock, bright moonlight through gnarled olive trees and a faint light of an angel; three disciples asleep on the ground nearby; torchlight approaching far down the hill; sorrow, trust, quiet.
scenes.judas_iscariot: Judas Iscariot, a tense man in his thirties holding a small bag of thirty silver coins in the temple council room before chief priests, then in the next moment in the temple flinging the coins onto the stone floor in despair; dark gold and gray tones, no violence shown; moral weight, sorrowful.
scenes.peters_denial: Peter warming himself at a charcoal fire in the courtyard of the high priest at night as a servant girl points at him; a rooster crows from a wall at dawn; Peter turning with a stricken face and shadows of guards; in the distance, a bound Jesus looks across the courtyard (seen only from afar, softly lit); bitter tears forming; heavy, sad.
scenes.pilate_barabbas: Pontius Pilate, a Roman governor in a purple-bordered toga seated on a judgment seat on a stone platform, washing his hands in a basin of water while a crowd roars; his wife's servant runs to whisper a warning; a tied prisoner, Barabbas, being freed to the side while Jesus (seen from afar, calm, bound hands) stands silent; heavy, dramatic, no violence shown.
scenes.crucifixion: Golgotha at midday going dark: three crosses seen far away on a hill as silhouettes under a dark sky with the middle cross simple and dignified (no wounds, no gore), women watching from a distance in grief, a Roman centurion looking up in awe, the temple curtain torn in two in the far background, earth trembling with cracked rocks and open tombs at the horizon; solemn, tender, reverent.
scenes.empty_tomb: Two women (Mary Magdalene and the other Mary) at dawn in front of an open rock tomb with the great stone rolled away, a radiant angel in white sitting on the stone, soldiers fallen like dead men on the ground; the women kneeling with astonished joy; in the background the risen Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) greets them with a gesture; golden sunrise over garden; wonder and joy.
scenes.great_commission: On a Galilean mountain at sunrise the eleven disciples, some kneeling, some uncertain, gather around Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) who stretches out both arms toward all directions; behind them a wide view of the world: distant lands and seas with many peoples; a beam of golden light and a gentle sense of 'I am with you always'; commissioning, hopeful and wide.

mark.setting: Setting: Roman-ruled Judea and Galilee in the early first century AD: whitewashed limestone villages with flat roofs and outdoor staircases, the Sea of Galilee with fishing boats and nets, rolling green hills and wheat fields, olive and fig trees, the Jordan river, a wilderness of pale rock, the stone-paved streets and temple of Jerusalem with Herod's grand portico, Roman soldiers in red cloaks and iron helmets, tax booths, wells and market stalls, oil lamps. Jesus is always shown with respect: a first-century Middle Eastern Jewish man in a simple undyed linen tunic and a plain cloak with tassels, with a gentle, serene, humble bearing, often seen from the side or behind, never a realistic close-up portrait, with a soft warm halo of light, not Western-medieval. Other people in linen and wool robes with indigo and madder-red stripes. Palette moves between warm golden Galilee mornings and deep blue night; sorrow scenes use stormy gray, dignified and never gory, no visible wounds or blood. Reverent, cinematic, tender.

scenes.jesus_son_of_god: Jesus of Nazareth in motion, a first-century Galilean Jewish man in a simple undyed linen tunic and cloak, striding along a dusty road beside the Sea of Galilee at dawn with a few fishermen following, seen mostly from the side or behind with soft golden light, the crowd pressing in eagerly behind him; a sense of urgency and compassion, vivid cinematic movement; reverent, not a stiff portrait.
scenes.busy_day_capernaum: Capernaum at evening: the whole town gathered at the door of Simon Peter's house, sick people on mats, mothers with children, a man with a bandaged arm, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) lifting up Peter's mother-in-law by the hand while lamps glow in the windows; then, in a small inset at dawn, Jesus alone praying on a solitary hillside outside town as disciples search for him; warm lamplight and blue dawn.
scenes.roof_friends: Four friends on a flat roof of a crowded Capernaum house, breaking open the roof tiles and lowering a paralyzed man on his mat with ropes into the room below where Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) teaches; the crowd inside looks up astonished, dust and sunlight pouring through the hole; the man's hopeful face; scribes in the corner frowning; lively, joyful and tender.
scenes.lord_of_sabbath: A synagogue on the Sabbath: a man holds out his healed hand to show everyone as Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stands with a sorrowful look at hard-faced Pharisees in the corner who whisper; earlier in the background, disciples picking heads of grain in a golden field on the Sabbath; clear, calm and dramatic.
scenes.jesus_family: A crowded house in Galilee: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) sits inside teaching a crowd who sit around him on the floor; outside the doorway Mary and his brothers stand waiting and calling; Jesus gestures to those seated around him, 'here are my mother and my brothers'; warm, human, and slightly tense.
scenes.seed_grows: A farmer asleep at night in his house window and rising by day, while in the field the seed grows by itself: first a green blade, then the ear, then the full golden grain, in time-lapse panels across one wide landscape from dawn to harvest; a man with a sickle at the end; a mustard seed becoming a tree full of birds; gentle, pastoral and luminous.
scenes.storm_cushion: A fishing boat in a violent night storm on the Sea of Galilee, waves breaking over the sides, disciples frantic and bailing water, while Jesus sleeps peacefully in the stern with his head on a cushion; one disciple shakes his shoulder, and in the next moment Jesus stands raising a hand with the wind and waves going calm; lightning and moonlight; dramatic then serene.
scenes.legion: A wild rocky shore of the Gerasenes with tombs in the hillside: a tormented man with broken chains sits calmly now, clothed and in his right mind at Jesus' feet, a herd of pigs rushing down a steep bank into the sea in the background; townspeople at a distance in fear; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stands by a boat; the healed man later goes through a town telling people; intense, then peaceful.
scenes.hem_of_garment: A crowd pressing around Jesus (seen from behind, softly lit) in a narrow street; a thin, tired woman bent low reaching out from the crowd to touch the fringe of his cloak, a faint warm glow passing from the cloak to her; the next moment she kneels trembling before him as he turns; disciples gesturing at the crowd; tender and tense.
scenes.jairus_daughter: A hushed bedroom in Capernaum: a twelve-year-old girl lying on a bed, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) holding her hand while her father Jairus, a synagogue ruler in a fine robe, and her mother watch with disbelieving joy; mourners and flute-players left outside the door; the girl opening her eyes and sitting up; soft morning light through a window; deeply tender.
scenes.five_loaves_mark: A huge crowd seated in groups of hundreds and fifties on fresh green grass on a hillside above a lake like a patchwork of colored garments, disciples carrying baskets of bread and fish among them from Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) standing with arms raised and looking up to heaven; sunset light, twelve baskets of leftovers; joyful and abundant.
scenes.bethsaida_blind: A blind man led gently by the hand by Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) out of the village of Bethsaida; in the first panel he squints with blurred vision, seeing people like trees walking; in the second panel his eyes widen and he sees clearly, a wide smile; the village behind, evening gold; tender, hopeful, two-stage healing.
scenes.take_up_cross: Jesus (seen from behind, softly lit) walking ahead on a road with a crowd and disciples, one disciple at the front looking back with a worried face as Jesus gestures and speaks about taking up one's cross; a plain wooden beam leaning against a rock near the road; the whole world shown as a bright globe at the horizon against a small human soul; thoughtful, serious.
scenes.help_my_unbelief: A father kneeling in tears in front of Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) at the foot of a mountain, his young son lying on the ground exhausted after a seizure, disciples and scribes arguing in the background crowd; the father's face full of raw honesty and hope as Jesus lifts the boy by the hand; emotional, human.
scenes.children_welcome: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) sitting on a stone bench in a village square with small children climbing into his lap and around him, a baby in his arms, mothers behind, disciples trying to keep them back and being gently stopped by his raised hand; soft golden afternoon, joy and tenderness.
scenes.rich_man_loved: A rich young man in fine embroidered robes kneeling on the road before Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit), who looks at him with love; the young man's face falls and he walks away sorrowfully past his servants and a fine mule laden with goods; a needle with a camel silhouette in the distance; disciples astonished; warm, bittersweet.
scenes.cup_and_ransom: James and John, two sturdy brothers, asking Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) for the seats of honor while the other ten disciples look indignant; Jesus gently holding out an empty cup as a sign and then kneeling with a basin to serve, showing greatness as service; a powerful sunlit road to Jerusalem behind them; clear, humble.
scenes.bartimaeus: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar sitting by the roadside outside Jericho in a worn cloak, calling out with hands raised and then throwing off his cloak and leaping up toward Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) who stands still and calls him; the crowd trying to quiet him and then helping him forward; palm trees, bright morning light; joyful faith.
scenes.widows_coins: The temple treasury courtyard: wealthy people dropping heavy bags of coins into large trumpet-shaped chests with a show, and a poor widow in a plain dark veil quietly dropping in two tiny copper coins; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) sitting nearby watching and drawing his disciples' attention to her; the widow's face humble and peaceful; golden light on her; tender.
scenes.watch_olivet: The Mount of Olives at dusk overlooking the temple of Jerusalem: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) sitting with Peter, James, John and Andrew, pointing toward the great temple stones; a gatekeeper standing awake at a door in the foreground keeping watch with a lamp through the night hours; stars and clouds, a rooster silhouette on a roof; vigilant and serious.
scenes.simon_cyrene: A strong man from the country, Simon of Cyrene, in a plain traveler's tunic with dusty feet, being pulled by a Roman soldier out of the crowd to carry a heavy wooden cross-beam up a street of Jerusalem ahead of Jesus (seen far behind, bowed, softly lit), two young sons (Alexander and Rufus) watching from the crowd's edge; early morning, solemn and human.
scenes.women_afraid: Three women (Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome) with jars of spices running from an open rock tomb at dawn, their veils flying, faces full of trembling astonishment; inside the tomb a young man in a white robe sitting where the body lay; the great stone rolled aside; a sky turning to gold behind them; wonder and fear.

scenes.luke_physician: Luke, a thoughtful educated Greek-speaking man in his forties in a plain tunic, sitting at a wooden desk by an oil lamp in a first-century study, writing carefully on a papyrus scroll with a reed pen, shelves with scrolls and a small physician's bag with herb jars nearby, a map of the Mediterranean and a window view of a harbor; patient, careful, warm lamp light; friend Theophilus implied by an empty chair.
scenes.priest_zechariah: The old priest Zechariah in white linen at the incense altar of the temple's Holy Place, struck with fear as the angel Gabriel, a tall radiant figure in white-gold light, stands at the right of the altar of incense; smoke rising, worshippers praying outside in the courtyard; later Zechariah mute writing a name on a wax tablet while Elizabeth smiles beside baby John; reverent and warm.
scenes.annunciation: The angel Gabriel, a radiant tall figure in soft white and gold light, appearing to the young Mary in the humble room of her Nazareth house, she kneeling or standing in wonder with her hands lowered in humble acceptance, a simple table with a jar and weaving; night lamp glow and a warm shaft of heavenly light; gentle, luminous and reverent.
scenes.magnificat: Mary and her older cousin Elizabeth embracing at the door of a hill-country house in Judea, both glowing with joy, Elizabeth's hand on Mary's stomach and Mary singing with her face lifted to the sky; spring hills, olive trees and a small garden; golden afternoon light and a faint ring of musical notes of light; joyful, intimate.
scenes.shepherds_angels: Shepherds on a dark hillside near Bethlehem at night, startled and then amazed as the sky opens with a great host of angels glowing in gold and white above the flock, a bright messenger angel descending; a small village with a faint light in a stable far in the valley; sheep, a campfire, cloaks and staffs; awe, then joy.
scenes.simeon_anna: Old Simeon, a devout man with a white beard in a prayer shawl, holding the baby Jesus tenderly in his arms in the temple court, his face lifted in joy and tears; Mary and Joseph standing by with two turtledoves in a basket; on the other side the aged prophetess Anna, thin and bent in dark robes, raising her hands in thanksgiving; shafts of light through temple columns; tender and golden.
scenes.boy_in_temple: Twelve-year-old Jesus (face modest, seen partly from the side) sitting among scholars and teachers in a temple portico, listening and asking questions, the white-bearded teachers amazed; at the entrance Mary and Joseph arriving anxious and relieved; a pilgrim crowd in the background; warm golden stone, curious and gentle.
scenes.nazareth_synagogue: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) standing in the synagogue of Nazareth reading from an open scroll of Isaiah, the attendant waiting, the congregation of villagers seated on stone benches watching him with surprise, some hostile; in a corner he hands the scroll back; a faint glow of a prophecy of release: chains falling, a blind person seeing; dramatic, quiet.
scenes.catch_of_fish: A fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee at dawn with nets so full of fish they begin to tear, a second boat coming to help, fish spilling; Peter on his knees in the boat at Jesus' knees (Jesus seen from the side, softly lit) saying 'depart from me, I am a sinful man'; James and John astonished; glittering silver fish and golden light on water; awe and wonder.
scenes.widow_nain: A funeral procession leaving the gate of the town of Nain, a pallbearer group carrying a young man on a bier, a grieving widow in dark clothes walking beside him with tears; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stopping them with a gentle hand on the bier, the young man sitting up and beginning to speak; mourners stunned; warm evening light, deeply compassionate.
scenes.perfume_feet: A banquet in a Pharisee's house: a woman who is known in the town as a sinner kneels weeping at Jesus' feet (Jesus seen from the side, softly lit, reclining at table), her hair wiping his feet, an alabaster jar of perfume open beside her; the Pharisee host Simon looks on with disdain from his place at the table; a gentle shaft of light on her bowed head; tender, intimate.
scenes.good_samaritan: A dusty Jericho road through rocky hills: a Samaritan traveler in plain robes kneeling to bind the wounds of a robbed and beaten man, pouring oil and wine, his donkey waiting; in the background a priest and a Levite walking away on the other side of the road; an inn on the horizon; compassionate, warm and realistic, no gore.
scenes.martha_and_mary: A Bethany home: Mary sitting at Jesus' feet (Jesus seen from the side, softly lit) listening peacefully on a rug, while Martha in the background hurries with dishes and a pot, her face flustered, turning to speak to Jesus; warm interior, lamps, bread and a table half set; gentle, human, a bit humorous.
scenes.rich_fool: A rich farmer standing proudly before his great barns bursting with grain, planning bigger ones, a plan scroll in hand and a feast table behind him; at night a hand of shadowed light and a candle gutters as a faint skeleton-like silhouette suggests death (no gore); empty-handed in the end; ironic, moral, moody.
scenes.lost_sheep_coin: Two panels in one: a shepherd with a sheep across his shoulders returning over hills at dawn and calling friends to celebrate; a woman with a lamp sweeping her small house to find a lost silver coin, then holding it up joyfully before neighbors; angels rejoicing faintly in the sky above; warm, joyful, lamplit.
scenes.prodigal_son: A father running down a road to embrace a thin, ragged young son returning home from a far country; the father's fine robe, a servant bringing the best robe, ring and sandals; in the background the elder brother standing stiff at the field's edge; pigs and a far country glimpsed in a corner; golden sunset light, the fattened calf being prepared; tender, emotional.
scenes.rich_man_lazarus: A split scene: a rich man in purple robes feasting at a lavish table in a house with a gate; at the gate lies the beggar Lazarus covered in sores with dogs licking them, hoping for scraps; in the sky above a vision of Abraham's bosom with Lazarus comforted in light, and across a great chasm the rich man in torment looking up; solemn, symbolic, no gore.
scenes.ten_lepers: Ten men with ragged cloths and bandaged skin standing at a distance outside a village, calling out to Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit); one of them, a Samaritan, running back, falling at Jesus' feet with joy, healed, the other nine disappearing down the road; sunlit road with olive trees; joyful, grateful.
scenes.persistent_widow: A determined widow in dark clothes standing before a stern judge on a raised seat in a hall, hands clasped and eyes steady, pleading again and again, the judge yawning and annoyed; a doorway shows she came repeatedly in sunrise and sunset; at the edge a luminous suggestion of justice (scales) waiting; warm and slightly humorous, parable-style.
scenes.two_men_pray: The temple court: a proud Pharisee in fine prayer robes standing near the front, praying to himself with lifted chin and listing his deeds; at the back, far away, a tax collector with his head bowed, beating his breast with eyes lowered; a soft shaft of light falls on the tax collector; stark, contrasting, quiet.
scenes.zacchaeus: A short wealthy tax collector, Zacchaeus, in a rich robe, climbing a sycamore-fig tree on a crowded street in Jericho to see over the crowd, his face eager; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stopping beneath the tree and looking up to call him down; the crowd muttering at the edges; sunlit palms; joyful, a little comic and tender.
scenes.weeping_over_jerusalem: Jesus (seen from the side or behind, softly lit) standing on the Mount of Olives at dusk, weeping as he looks over the golden city of Jerusalem and its temple glowing in the evening; disciples behind him in silence; faint sketches of walls and armies in the clouds as warning; sorrow and love; muted gold and violet.
scenes.paradise_criminal: Golgotha at midday in softer focus: three crosses on a hill seen from a distance as silhouettes (no gore); on the left cross a criminal turning his head toward the middle cross; a soft shaft of warm light spreading from the middle cross toward him, with a faint vision of a garden of paradise in the sky; women and soldiers small at the base; reverent, tender.
scenes.emmaus_road: A road at sunset to the village of Emmaus: two disciples walking with a third stranger (Jesus seen from the side with face in soft shadow and warm light, in simple robes), gesturing and speaking while the two listen with hearts glowing; then in an inset at a simple inn table he breaks bread and their eyes open with wonder; warm orange sky; wonder and joy.
scenes.ascension_commission: On the Mount of Olives near Bethany, Jesus (seen from behind or the side, softly lit) with arms raised in blessing as he is carried up into a bright cloud above the disciples, who kneel and look up with joy; open scrolls of the Law, Prophets and Psalms glimpsed at their feet; Jerusalem in the distance; luminous, reverent, joyful.
scenes.seventy_sent: Seventy two-by-two travelers in simple cloaks and sandals leaving a village at dawn along roads in pairs, carrying no bags or purses, toward distant towns with a wide harvest field behind them; above them a vision of lightning falling like a star from heaven; joyful faces and a returning pair reporting to Jesus (seen from the side); bright and hopeful.
