scenes.jesus_logos: A cosmic-to-earthly vision: out of a deep dark sky a great shaft of golden light descends into a simple Galilean village and gathers into a human figure of Jesus (seen from behind, softly lit, simple linen tunic and cloak) standing among ordinary neighbors in a lane at dawn; stars, a river of light, and a tiny lamp in a window; the feeling of 'the Word became flesh and lived among us'; luminous, reverent, never a stiff portrait.
scenes.john_witness: John the Baptist, a lean prophet in camel hair standing at the Jordan river at Bethany beyond the Jordan, pointing with one arm toward Jesus (seen far away from behind, softly lit) walking along the river bank; a lamb in the foreground drinking from the water; a dove of light in the sky; a few of John's disciples looking where he points, Andrew among them; golden late-afternoon light, quiet and clear.
scenes.nathanael: Nathanael, a straightforward Galilean man under a fig tree in the shade of a village at midday with a book scroll on his knee, then in the next moment walking with Philip toward Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) who smiles and greets him; Nathanael's startled face; the fig tree's shadow and a ladder of light with angels ascending and descending above them; warm and gently humorous.
scenes.wine_at_cana: A wedding feast at Cana in Galilee: six large stone water jars at the side of the courtyard filled to the brim, servants pouring dark red wine into a cup for the master of the feast who tastes it with surprised delight; Mary quietly directing the servants, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) calmly in the background; lanterns, garlands, dancing guests; warm joyful colors.
scenes.nicodemus: Nicodemus, an older Pharisee leader in rich robes and a white-gray beard, visiting Jesus at night on a rooftop terrace of a Jerusalem house lit by a single oil lamp, listening intently, one hand raised in a question; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) gesturing as the night wind blows; a faint outline of a bronze serpent on a pole in the sky above, and stars; intimate, quiet, blue night and lamp gold.
scenes.woman_at_well: A Samaritan woman in a veiled dress with a water jar at Jacob's well in the midday sun beside a stone well and a dry plain, in conversation with Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) who sits tired at the wellhead; the mountain of Gerizim in the background; she looks astonished; in a small inset she runs back to the town leaving her water jar, calling the people; warm and bright.
scenes.boy_with_loaves: A small boy with a basket of five barley loaves and two small fish held up hopefully to Andrew, a Galilean fisherman crouching to his level, with Philip behind scratching his head at the thousands of people seated on the grassy hill; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) in the background looking at the boy's offering with a smile; fresh green grass and a bright afternoon sky; warm and tender.
scenes.bread_of_life: Capernaum synagogue and a crowd arguing and some leaving: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) standing before a table with a loaf of bread, a cup of water and a manna jar; faces in the crowd show confusion, anger and a few moved; on a wall behind, a faint golden painting of manna falling in the wilderness; Peter, with the Twelve, saying 'to whom would we go?'; sober, strong, golden light.
scenes.woman_caught_adultery: The temple court at dawn: a frightened woman in a rumpled dress kneeling on the stone pavement encircled by scribes and Pharisees holding stones; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stooping to write on the dust with his finger, then standing; the accusers dropping their stones one by one and walking away from oldest to youngest; the woman looking up with relief and tears; soft morning light; tender and tense.
scenes.man_born_blind: A man blind from birth in a Jerusalem street, a clay-smeared face, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) stooping to anoint his eyes with mud; then in the second panel the man washing at the Pool of Siloam, water running down his face and opening his eyes to see the sunlit city for the first time with amazed joy; neighbors and Pharisees watching with astonishment; bright, joyful.
scenes.good_shepherd: A shepherd (seen from the side, softly lit, plain robe, staff) leading a flock of sheep through a sheepfold gate at dawn, calling them by name; sheep following and looking up to him; in the background a thief climbing over the wall in shadow and a wolf at the edge of a dark hillside, the shepherd stepping forward to protect them; green pasture with a stream; warm and strong.
scenes.lazarus_raised: The tomb of Lazarus at Bethany, a stone cave entrance with a great round stone rolled away, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) standing in front with a loud voice calling; Lazarus emerging from the dark in grave wrappings with his face covered in cloth, people unwrapping him; Martha and Mary kneeling in tears and wonder; mourners astonished; light breaking in from the sky; powerful, emotional.
scenes.perfume_bethany: A dinner at Bethany: Mary kneeling at Jesus' feet (Jesus seen from the side, softly lit, reclining) pouring a pound of costly pure nard from an alabaster jar, wiping his feet with her loose hair; the whole room glowing as if filled with fragrance; Judas at the table in shadow frowning with a moneybag; Martha serving in the background; Lazarus reclining, alive; warm lamplight, tender.
scenes.foot_washing: The upper room: Jesus (seen from behind, softly lit) kneeling on the floor with a towel around his waist, washing the feet of a disciple (Peter, startled, pulling his foot back), a basin of water and a jug beside, the other disciples watching in stunned silence; oil lamps and a low supper table; intimate, humble, warm gold light.
scenes.way_truth_life: The upper room after supper: Thomas and Philip asking questions with open hands while Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) answers, with a path of light stretching from the room through a door into a distant house with many rooms glowing in the sky; troubled faces calmed; evening gold and deep blue; gentle reassurance.
scenes.the_helper: Disciples in a dark room at night, anxious, and a soft living breath of golden wind and flame-like light (the Spirit) settling quietly among them like a comforting companion, a candle brightening, shown as a gentle warm presence beside each disciple (no figure with a face), peace in their faces; the dark window behind with the world outside; tender, luminous.
scenes.vine_and_branches: A great grapevine in a vineyard at sunset with thick fruitful branches growing from one strong trunk, a gardener pruning a branch gently with a small knife and another dry branch cut off and gathered into a small fire; Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) with his hand on the vine speaking to the disciples among the rows; ripe clusters glowing; warm and symbolic.
scenes.priestly_prayer: Jesus (seen from behind, softly lit) lifting his eyes to heaven in prayer under the open night sky on the way to Gethsemane, with eleven disciples gathered close behind him and a great luminous ring of figures of all nations and ages across the sky forming one body; stars and a river of light; intimate, hushed, majestic.
scenes.what_is_truth: Pilate, a Roman governor in a purple-bordered toga, in the courtyard of the praetorium at dawn, turning away from Jesus (seen from the side, bound hands, calm and softly lit) with a puzzled dismissive gesture as if asking 'what is truth?'; Roman guards, a crowd outside the gates not entering to stay ceremonially clean; gold and stone, tense and quiet.
scenes.it_is_finished: Golgotha at midday seen from a distance: three crosses silhouetted on a hill under a darkening sky (no wounds, no gore), and at the foot of the middle cross Jesus' mother Mary, her sister, Mary of Clopas and Mary Magdalene standing together, with the beloved disciple gently taking Mary's arm as he is given to her; a soft golden light on the group; solemn, tender, modest.
scenes.mary_at_tomb: Mary Magdalene at dawn in a garden outside an open rock tomb, weeping and looking in, then turning with surprise as Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit, mistaken for a gardener) says her name; her hands reaching out, tears and joy; olive trees, dew and a sunrise gold; two angels in white inside the tomb in the background; deeply emotional and luminous.
scenes.thomas_doubt: An upper room with closed doors: Thomas, a thoughtful disciple, reaching out one hand toward Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) who shows his open hands, with the other disciples around; Thomas's face overcome with awe, a quiet golden light filling the room; the door locked behind; intimate, wondrous.
scenes.charcoal_breakfast: The Sea of Tiberias at dawn: a charcoal fire on the beach with fish cooking and bread, Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) standing on the shore calling to seven disciples in a boat a hundred yards out with a net full of 153 fish; Peter plunging into the water to swim toward him; mist and pink sunrise; joyful and warm.
scenes.peter_restored: A quiet scene on the beach after breakfast: Jesus (seen from the side, softly lit) and Peter walking along the shore together, Jesus asking him three times 'do you love me?', Peter grieved but earnest with a hand on his chest; the charcoal fire smoking behind and the beloved disciple following at a distance; morning light on the water; tender, honest.

acts.setting: Setting: the Roman Mediterranean world of the mid first century AD: Jerusalem's temple courts and upper rooms, Judean hill towns, the coastal road to Caesarea and Joppa, Antioch of Syria with its colonnaded streets, Philippi, Athens with the Areopagus hill and white marble temples, Corinth's harbor and workshops, Ephesus with the great theater and the temple of Artemis, ships on the Mediterranean, Roman soldiers, centurions and officials in red cloaks, synagogues and house churches. Garments of undyed linen and wool with indigo and madder-red stripes, Roman tunics and togas, traveler's cloaks and sandals. Early believers shown as ordinary working people of all ages and nations. Palette moves between warm golden Galilean sunlight, sea blue, marble white and the warm firelight of Pentecost; dramatic scenes never gory. Reverent, cinematic and adventurous.

scenes.paul: Paul, a short, sturdy, bearded man in his forties with a tireless, intelligent face and a bald forehead, in a traveler's cloak, sitting on a stool in a tentmaker's workshop in Corinth with leather and cloth, an awl and a scroll beside him, writing a letter by lamplight while a harbor with ships glows through a window; sealed scrolls and a road map of cities on a table; resolute, warm and hardworking.
scenes.ascension_acts: On the Mount of Olives, the eleven apostles and some women looking up as Jesus (seen from behind and below, softly lit, arms raised in blessing) is lifted into a bright cloud, two men in white standing beside them pointing to heaven; olive trees and a view of Jerusalem; awe, joy and a sense of mission; luminous.
scenes.pentecost: An upper room in Jerusalem with open windows: about a hundred and twenty believers, men and women of all ages, gathered with raised faces while a rushing wind sweeps through and tongues of fire rest above each head like small golden flames; faces full of astonishment and joy; in the street outside, a crowd of pilgrims from many nations in varied dress turning and listening in amazement; warm firelight, dynamic and joyful.
scenes.peters_sermon: Peter, a broad-shouldered Galilean fisherman now bold, standing on the steps of a building in Jerusalem at Pentecost addressing a huge crowd of pilgrims from many nations, his arm raised; the eleven stand with him; faces in the crowd cut to the heart, some weeping, some stepping forward toward a water pool; three thousand people forming lines to be baptized in the background; bright morning, earnest.
scenes.shared_life: An early church household in Jerusalem: men and women sharing bread at a long table in a courtyard, children running about, a person laying down a bag of money at an apostle's feet, bread and wine in the center, doves on the roof; the temple glimpsed in the distance; warm, communal, generous.
scenes.barnabas_encourager: Barnabas, a warm, kind man from Cyprus in a Levite's plain robe, laying a bag of money from the sale of his field at the apostles' feet, then in the next moment taking a wary new convert, Saul, by the arm and leading him toward the cautious apostles in Jerusalem, a gentle encouraging smile on his face; golden light, trust and welcome.
scenes.lame_man_gate: At the Beautiful Gate of the Jerusalem temple, Peter and John stopping before a man lame from birth who sits begging on his mat; Peter holding out his right hand and pulling him up, the man's feet and ankles strengthening and him leaping, walking and praising God as the crowd rushes in astonished; the bronze gate gleaming; joyful and dynamic.
scenes.boldness_council: Peter and John, plain Galilean fishermen in simple robes, standing calm before a stern council of high priests and elders in rich robes seated in a semicircle in a stone hall; the healed man beside them silently making any answer impossible; the council whispering with worry; light from a high window falling on the two apostles; tense, courageous.
scenes.ananias_sapphira: A scene in the early church: Ananias, a well-dressed man, standing before Peter in a courtyard holding a purse of money, with Peter's steady gaze and an uneasy hush over the gathered believers; Sapphira waiting by the door behind; the weight of a lie felt in the shadows and a shaft of heavy light; solemn, no gore.
scenes.seven_chosen: Seven men of good reputation, among them Stephen and Philip, standing in a row before the apostles who lay hands on them in prayer, in a Jerusalem courtyard; Greek-speaking widows and Hebrew-speaking widows receiving bread from baskets at tables in the background; light of the Spirit; warm, organized, caring.
scenes.stephen_martyr: Stephen, a young man with a radiant face like an angel, standing in the open outside the city wall of Jerusalem looking up at an open sky with a vision of the glory of God and Jesus standing at God's right hand (a figure of light), stones around his feet and a crowd with raised arms in the distance (no gore); a young man named Saul guarding the cloaks at the edge; solemn, luminous, forgiving.
scenes.ethiopian_eunuch: A desert road south of Jerusalem toward Gaza: an Ethiopian court official in fine robes sitting in his chariot reading a scroll of Isaiah aloud, with Philip running alongside and then sitting beside him to explain; later both standing in a stream of water for baptism, the chariot waiting on the bank, an attendant looking on; hot golden desert light, joyful and curious.
scenes.damascus_road: Saul of Tarsus, a young Pharisee in fine robes with letters of authority, thrown from his horse onto the road near Damascus in a blinding light from heaven (no figure shown), his companions standing speechless with arms raised; Saul on his knees with hands over his eyes; the walls of Damascus in the distance; dust, dazzling white-gold light and astonishment.
scenes.ananias_disciple: Ananias, a quiet disciple in Damascus, entering a house on Straight Street and laying his hands on the blind Saul who sits waiting in prayer; scales falling from Saul's eyes like flakes of light as he looks up with wonder; a lamp and a bowl of bread nearby; gentle, brave and warm.
scenes.tabitha: An upper room in Joppa: the disciple Tabitha (Dorcas) opening her eyes and sitting up on the bed as Peter kneeling beside her holds her hand; weeping widows in the room holding out tunics and cloaks she had made, now turning to joy; soft morning light through a window; tender and moving.
scenes.cornelius_peter: Two connected visions: Peter on a rooftop in Joppa at noon seeing a great sheet let down from the sky with creatures of all kinds, under a bright sky; and in Caesarea Cornelius, a Roman centurion in a red cloak, welcoming Peter at the door of his house with a crowd of family and friends inside; the Holy Spirit falling like a gentle light on the gathered Gentiles as Peter speaks; warm, surprising, joyful.
scenes.antioch_church: A bustling street in Antioch of Syria with colonnades: a mixed group of Jews and Greeks gathering in a house church, Barnabas and Saul teaching, a warm lamp-lit hall full of people of different backgrounds; a relief offering being prepared for Jerusalem; the disciples first called 'Christians' as a sign above the city; golden, welcoming, multicultural.
scenes.jerusalem_council: A council hall in Jerusalem: apostles and elders seated in a half-circle listening to Peter and James as Paul and Barnabas report with gestures on the miracles among the Gentiles; a scroll with a letter being sealed for delivery to Antioch; Gentile believers waiting in the courtyard hopefully; a mood of dialogue and resolution; warm, solemn.
scenes.lydia_philippi: A riverside outside Philippi at the Sabbath: women gathered on the bank to pray, among them Lydia, a dignified seller of purple cloth with bolts of purple fabric beside her, listening intently to Paul as her heart opens; in a dream-bubble above the water, a man of Macedonia calling 'come over and help us'; Paul, Silas, Timothy and Luke seated on the bank; golden morning light.
scenes.philippian_jailer: A deep prison cell at midnight in Philippi: Paul and Silas in stocks singing hymns with lifted faces, prisoners listening, an earthquake splitting the walls and loosening chains; a jailer in a Roman tunic drawing his sword in despair then dropping to his knees before them; at dawn the whole household baptized at a basin; dramatic, then joyful.
scenes.areopagus: Paul standing on the Areopagus (Mars Hill) in Athens speaking to a crowd of Stoic and Epicurean philosophers in white robes, with the Parthenon and marble temples behind and an altar with a worn carved inscription ('to an unknown god', no readable letters) at his side; some listeners mock, others lean in; clear Athenian morning light; thoughtful, bold.
scenes.priscilla_aquila: A tentmaker's workshop in Corinth: Priscilla and Aquila, a hardworking married couple in plain tunics, sewing goat-hair cloth with Paul at the same bench, a scroll open on the table; in the next panel they gently teach the eloquent Apollos in a quiet corner of their house; lamplight, warm shared work; friendly and domestic.
scenes.ephesus_riot: The great theater of Ephesus filled with tens of thousands in an uproar, silversmiths holding up small silver shrines of Artemis, the crowd chanting 'Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!' with fists in the air, a town clerk calming them from the stage; Paul's companions Gaius and Aristarchus held at the edge; sunlit marble, loud and chaotic but not violent.
scenes.eutychus: A crowded third-floor room in Troas at night with many lamps, Paul still teaching with a scroll, a young man Eutychus nodding off in a window sill; in the next panel Paul kneeling in the street below and embracing the fallen young man, a look of relief on the crowd's faces; later the whole group eating bread together at dawn; warm, human and a bit humorous.
scenes.miletus_farewell: On a beach at Miletus: Paul, tired but steady, kneeling in prayer with the Ephesian elders gathered round him, many weeping, embracing and kissing him as he leaves for the ship waiting in the harbor; a tender crowd at the water's edge, gulls and the sea; evening gold; deeply emotional.
scenes.shipwreck_malta: A great grain ship broken in a violent storm off the coast of Malta at dawn, men swimming and clinging to planks toward a rocky shore; Paul calm and steady among them with lifted hands; later a bonfire on the beach with islanders warming survivors and a viper on Paul's hand shaken harmlessly into the fire; dramatic, hopeful.
scenes.paul_in_rome: Paul, an older man in a simple rented house in Rome, chained lightly to a Roman soldier (a guard in a plain tunic) at his side, receiving a crowd of visitors in a bright room, teaching with open hands, a scroll and writing materials on a table, sunlight falling through a window over the city; quiet boldness and hope; warm gold.

romans.setting: Setting: the Roman world in the mid first century AD: the great city of Rome with marble forum, aqueducts and crowded apartment blocks and small house churches in humble rooms; Corinth and its harbor at Cenchreae where Paul writes with a scribe; ships, roads and traveling merchants; Jewish synagogues and Gentile homes; olive groves; Roman soldiers, slaves and citizens in tunics and togas; ordinary believers of different nations sharing a meal. Palette moves between warm lamplit interiors, bright Mediterranean sea blue and olive green, with luminous gold for grace and storm gray for sin. Symbolic and cinematic, reverent, never gory; thought-provoking diagrams made visual as scenes.

scenes.paul_romans: Paul, short, bearded and intense, in a plain tunic dictating a long letter to a young scribe, Tertius, at a wooden table in a lamplit room in Corinth, a scroll unrolled across the table, a harbor with ships glowing through the window; sealed scrolls and a map of the road to Rome and Spain beside him; warm and focused.
scenes.power_of_gospel: A bright golden shaft of light breaking through storm clouds over the great city of Rome and spreading in rings across the whole Mediterranean world to Jew and Greek alike, ships and travelers on roads lifting their faces to it; at the foreground a small scroll and a writing hand of a prophet in the margin (no text); power, hope, scale.
scenes.no_one_righteous: A solemn courtroom of the whole world: people of every nation and rank standing silent before a great luminous judge's bench (no figure shown), mouths closed, with open throats like graves of dust, feet running after quarrels, the whole world silenced under the law; heavy storm light, symbolic and serious, no gore.
scenes.righteousness_apart_law: A radiant scene of a slave market of freedom: a prisoner's chains being struck off by a great hand of light at an altar-like mercy seat, a ransom paid with a shining coin-like light, the person walking free into a golden field, a great scale balanced in grace beside them; all kinds of people standing on level ground together; luminous, joyful, symbolic.
scenes.abraham_faith: Old Abraham in a desert camp at night looking up at an uncountable field of stars with open hands, Sarah in the tent door behind him, his face full of trust; a faint outline of a great future family of many nations in the starry sky; sand dunes and a single lit tent; luminous, awed and quiet.
scenes.peace_with_god: A calm harbor at dawn after a long storm: a battered ship tying up at a quay, the crew stepping onto land with relief, a lighthouse glowing; a warm shaft of light touching a small group of people embracing; a flowing river of gold poured into hearts as light; peace, hope and love; soft sunrise.
scenes.adam_and_christ: A symbolic double scene: on the left, the first man Adam, in a garden of dying leaves, a long shadow of death spreading behind him over generations; on the right, a bright new figure of Christ-like light (no face details) standing in a flourishing garden where grace overflows like a spring, people crossing from shadow into light; painterly, balanced and symbolic.
scenes.baptized_into_death: A river baptism scene: a person going down into water with hands crossed, the old self in a dark robe sinking away behind them like a shadow while they rise into bright morning light in a white garment, walking in a new life along a green bank; a chain of broken fetters at the water's edge; hopeful and clear.
scenes.wretched_man: A troubled man in a small lamp-lit room at night, hunched at a table over an open scroll of the law, his hands pressed to his head in anguish; two shadowy versions of himself pulling in opposite directions on the wall; a thin ray of dawn through a window offering hope; inner conflict, honest and heavy.
scenes.no_condemnation: A courtroom dissolving into light: the gavel and the scroll of accusation falling to the floor as a great warm light fills the chamber and a child runs forward into the arms of a luminous father figure (no face, only light) crying 'Abba'; chains crumbling; a dove-like glow over the child; joyful, tender, liberating.
scenes.creation_groans: Creation groaning like labor pains: an earth landscape of hills, ocean and forests glowing and straining toward dawn, trees leaning toward the east, animals lifting their heads, a gentle wind and a sparkle of hope on the horizon; a person kneeling in prayer with the Spirit's soft glow helping their wordless sighs; wide, awe-filled.
scenes.nothing_separates: A vast panorama: a small person standing on a hill under a huge starry sky, around them swirling symbols of every threat (storm, sword, flood, fire, dark depths) harmlessly parting like waves, while a great warm arm of light surrounds them and holds them; angels and powers shown as faint silhouettes; triumphant and tender.
scenes.olive_tree: A great old olive tree in a Mediterranean grove at sunset: natural branches, some cut off, and wild olive branches grafted in by a gardener with a small knife, the whole tree flourishing with one root; people of many nations standing around it in wonder; a sense of humility and of a root that bears all; warm gold and green.
scenes.living_sacrifice: A person kneeling before a simple altar offering themselves as a living sacrifice, shown as giving their open hands and body with joy (no harm, only worship), a transformed mind symbolized by a caterpillar becoming a butterfly in a cloud of light; a community gathered around sharing gifts (teaching, serving, giving, leading) each with their own hand on a shared body; warm, bright, communal.
scenes.love_fulfills_law: A city street in Rome: neighbors helping neighbors, a debt scroll torn and a coin returned, a tax collector at a table with a calm Roman official in the background, a banner of 'love your neighbor' shown as a glowing heart-shaped lamp over a doorway; people of all ranks walking in daylight; ordered, warm, civic.
scenes.weak_and_strong: A shared dinner table in a Roman house church: some eating freely, others eating only vegetables, some observing a special day, looking at each other with respect rather than contempt, a bowl passed between them; the host smiling; a lamp glowing; mutual acceptance, humor and warmth.
scenes.phoebe_and_friends: Phoebe, a dignified woman patron of Cenchreae in a traveling cloak, carrying a sealed scroll (Paul's letter to Rome) onto a ship at the harbor while friends see her off; in an inset the house church in Rome greets her: Priscilla and Aquila, Andronicus and Junia, and others around a table; warm lamplight and a long list of names glowing like threads of light; affectionate and communal.

1corinthians.setting: Setting: Corinth in the early 50s AD, a busy Greek-Roman port city with two harbors, the Acrocorinth hill with a temple above, crowded markets with meat from idol temples, the Isthmian Games stadium and runners, wealthy and poor believers meeting in a large house church, slaves, free citizens and Jews and Greeks together; Ephesus where Paul writes with Sosthenes. Garments of linen and wool, richer togas for the wealthy, simple tunics for the poor; oil lamps, bread and cup, wax tablets and scrolls. Palette moves between warm lamplight and marble white, harbor blue and olive green; luminous for love and resurrection, sober for correction; never gory. Cinematic, human and varied.

scenes.paul_to_corinth: Paul in a crowded workshop room in Ephesus dictating a letter to his co-sender Sosthenes, with letters and written reports from Chloe's household on the table, a concerned and tender expression; a map of Corinth's two harbors glimpsed through a window; lamplight, scrolls, a pen; pastoral and urgent.
scenes.i_follow_paul: A divided meal in a Corinthian house church: small clusters of people with banners or armbands 'I belong to Paul', 'I belong to Apollos', 'I belong to Cephas', 'I belong to Christ' (no readable letters, just colors), turning their backs to one another around a long table, while an empty central place at the table glows with warm light; Paul's letter in a servant's hand; gentle irony and sadness.
scenes.word_of_the_cross: A great scene of reversed values: on one side a Greek philosopher and a Jewish scholar, scrolls in hand, shaking their heads at a plain wooden cross standing alone on a hill; on the other side ordinary Corinth believers, a slave, a craftswoman, a dock worker, a widow, looking at the cross with open faces, a shaft of light on it; a powerful golden glow in the foolishness; paradox, quiet awe.
scenes.spirit_searches: Two men: one reading a scroll in a library of the world's wisdom with a puzzled face, and one ordinary person under an open sky with a warm light from above pouring through her, the Spirit shown as a deep golden river reaching down into the depths of the sea of God's mind, with stars; 'eye has not seen' glimpsed as unseen treasures behind a veil; luminous and awed.
scenes.master_builder: A building site: a wise master builder (Paul) laying a stone foundation, with Apollos watering a young garden beside it; above, a lasting building rising with gold, silver and precious stone sections and another with wood, hay and straw catching in a test of fire; Jesus Christ as the cornerstone shown as a great glowing stone; the whole scene bright and symbolic; the church as God's temple.
scenes.stewards_servants: Servants of Christ as stewards: a faithful steward in a simple tunic sweeping a threshold and handing out bread to others from a storeroom full of precious sealed jars (the mysteries of God), while a crowd of grander men in rich robes look on; his face humble and content under a bright sky; gentle, modest, quiet.
scenes.little_yeast: A kitchen with a household clearing out old leaven before Passover: a woman sweeping the last crumbs of old sour leaven from the corners, a lamb prepared in the courtyard, a large lump of dough rising too much with a little leaven; a sense of cleansing and the sacrifice of Christ our Passover; warm and homely, no judgment faces.
scenes.body_a_temple: A believer standing in the doorway of a bright temple whose pillars are his own body, light streaming from within; outside the market of Corinth with tempting stalls and a street of shadows; a price tag in the form of a purchase seal on his heart (no readable letters) showing he was bought; a hand of light gently guiding him; modest, hopeful.
scenes.married_and_single: Two quiet scenes: a married couple, a man and wife, sharing a meal and listening to each other in a lamp-lit home, and a single person walking calmly in a busy marketplace with a serene, devoted face, each with their own gift from God shown as different colored lights; neighbors of all sorts in the background; gentle, respectful, ordinary.
scenes.food_offered_idols: A Corinthian market stall with meat sacrificed to idols hanging behind a temple, a confident Christian man (the 'strong') eating a meal at a friend's house and his sensitive friend (the 'weak') watching with a worried face; the strong man gently putting down his fork out of love; an idol shown small and hollow in the background while the one God glows; warm, human, thoughtful.
scenes.all_things_to_all: Paul adapting among different people in one panoramic scene: sitting with Jewish men in a synagogue wearing a tallit, with Gentiles at an agora table in plain Greek dress, with a poor man in rags, with a slave; then in the foreground running hard in a stadium race on a dusty track toward a laurel-wreath prize, focused and determined; sunlit, energetic.
scenes.the_lords_supper: A shared house-church supper in Corinth: believers, rich and poor together, around a table with bread and a cup lifted by a leader in front of an oil lamp, solemn and warm; in the background some people eating ahead while others wait hungry, then corrected and brought together as one table; a glow of remembrance; reverent, communal.
scenes.one_body_many_members: A great luminous body made of many people: hands, eyes, ears, feet and hearts, each a different person of different nation, rank and gift (a teacher, a healer, a helper, a leader, a prophet, an interpreter) joined in one body in a courtyard of light; Jews and Greeks, slaves and free, honoring the weaker members more; golden thread joining them; warm, harmonious, symbolic.
scenes.love_is_patient: An intimate scene of love in daily life: a patient mother with a fretting child, a man giving way to his neighbor at a narrow doorway, two old friends embracing after an argument, a person giving water to a stranger; around them a huge soft golden ring of light formed by their gestures, with faint tongues of fire and a stack of scrolls (prophecies and knowledge) fading to one small lit lamp remaining: faith, hope and love; warm, gentle, luminous.
scenes.order_in_worship: A lively but orderly house-church worship: one person prophesying with a scroll, another interpreting, a singer with a lyre, and listeners attending; a newcomer, an outsider, sitting in the center hearing clearly and being moved; a lamp-lit hall with well-arranged turns of speakers; peaceful, decent and joyful.
scenes.resurrection_chapter: Christ's resurrection as the first fruits: an empty tomb at dawn with a golden sheaf of first fruits glowing at its mouth, and behind it a vast field of grain waving in a sunrise, the harvest of the risen; in the sky trumpets of light and a great multitude of people rising transformed from fields and graveyards in the moment of change; a dark figure of death falling away; triumphant, luminous, joyous.
scenes.collection_for_saints: The first day of the week in a Corinthian household: each person setting aside a little money in a small jar for the poor saints in Jerusalem, a table with coins and a ledger, Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arriving with greetings, Aquila and Priscilla's house church greeting; Paul's last words in his own hand as a signed scroll; 'Maranatha' as a rising dawn; warm, communal.

2corinthians.setting: Setting: Macedonia and Corinth in the mid-50s AD, Paul writing from Macedonia (Philippi) after leaving Ephesus; Roman roads, Philippi and Thessalonica, Corinth's harbor and marketplace, a city wall at Damascus, the collection for Jerusalem, Moses on Sinai with a shining face. Linen and wool tunics, tentmaker's goat-hair cloth, clay jars and oil lamps, scrolls, wax tablets and pens, incense, a Roman triumph procession. Palette: warm lamplight, terracotta and clay, gold light spilling through cracks, night indigo; luminous for glory and comfort, sober for suffering; never gory. Cinematic, tender, human and varied.

scenes.paul_writes_again: Paul in a modest room in Macedonia receiving Titus who has just arrived from Corinth with good news, the two men embracing with relief and tears, Timothy beside them with a scroll, a road leading toward Corinth visible through the window at dusk, letters and a lamp on the table; relief, tenderness and weariness.
scenes.god_of_all_comfort: A circle of afflicted people at night: a man with bandaged arms, a weeping widow, a former prisoner, a worn traveler from Asia, each being held and comforted by the next, a golden thread of comfort passing from hand to hand around the circle while a warm light as of a Father's arms enfolds them all from above; a faint storm and shadowy crowd fading in the background; tender, quiet, luminous.
scenes.tearful_letter: Split scene: Paul at night writing a letter with tears falling onto the papyrus beside an oil lamp; and in Corinth a house church hearing the letter read, a repentant man being embraced and forgiven by the congregation, hands on shoulders; warm lamplight, sorrow turning into reconciliation; gentle, human.
scenes.aroma_of_christ: A Roman triumphal procession in a street at midday with incense bearers, with Paul and his co-workers walking as willing captives led by Christ shown only as a bright light at the front; thick golden incense smoke drifting over the crowd, some onlookers breathing it in with pleasure, others turning away; festive and paradoxical; vivid color.
scenes.letter_of_christ: A congregation of ordinary Corinth believers as living letters: faint shining script written in light on their hearts and faces, read by passers-by; in the foreground a cracked stone tablet beside a human heart glowing with writing from a pen of flame (the Spirit), a discarded letter of recommendation scroll aside; Paul reading their faces with joy; warm, intimate.
scenes.unveiled_faces: Moses coming down Mount Sinai with a radiant face and a veil, the Israelites shrinking back; beside it, in the foreground, a believer lifting a veil from her face in a bright room, looking at a mirror of glory, her face beginning to shine and brighter and brighter in a series of ever-increasing light; glory to glory transformation; vivid, luminous.
scenes.treasure_in_clay: A cracked clay jar glowing from within, golden light shining out through the cracks and spilling over battered hands holding it; behind, a narrow street with walls pressing on every side, a man still standing, knocked down but rising, fear and trouble around but a steady light inside; beauty in fragility; warm terracotta and gold.
scenes.earthly_tent: A tentmaker (Paul) folding a goat-hair tent at dusk in a desert camp, tools beside him, while above a house of light 'not made with hands' appears in the sky, a luminous eternal dwelling; he looks up with longing and calm; inner and outer person shown: aging weathered body, a young bright flame within; serene, hopeful, twilight.
scenes.new_creation: An ambassador scene of reconciliation: Paul as Christ's ambassador in a plain robe pleading with estranged people, two groups of former enemies embracing across a divide; in the corner a person stepping out of tattered old clothes into a new white garment with fresh green shoots sprouting around; Christ's love as a gentle constraining light; bright, joyful.
scenes.as_dying_yet_alive: A tapestry of paradoxes in one scene: Paul and a companion in a dim prison cell with joyous faces; a poor man with empty hands handing loaves to many; a figure collapsed yet standing again; 'unknown yet well known' a humble man greeted by a crowd; behind them an open door at dawn, 'now is the day of salvation'; humble, hopeful, golden dawn.
scenes.unequally_yoked: Two mismatched animals, an ox and a donkey, yoked to one plow and pulling in different directions, while at the field's edge a clear path leads to a bright temple and a gentle hand beckons; on the other side an idol shrine in shadow; a boundary where light meets darkness; respectful, thoughtful, not mocking.
scenes.godly_sorrow: Titus arriving in Macedonia with news of the Corinthians' repentance, and in Corinth a church setting its house in order with earnestness: tears turning to relief, people clearing out a room, opening windows, mending a broken thing together; a faint heart being repaired with gold; hopeful and warm.
scenes.macedonian_gift: Poor Macedonian believers in Philippi and Thessalonica giving joyfully out of deep poverty: a woman placing a small purse, a man in a patched tunic with coins, a chest receiving the collection, a delegation with Titus ready to carry it to Jerusalem; above, a figure of light bowing down toward them as Christ who became poor; joyful faces; warm and communal.
scenes.cheerful_giver: A farmer sowing seed generously from an open bag across a wide field, with rows of rich harvest in the middle distance; in the foreground a cheerful giver placing coins into a basket with a smile and a receiver lifting thanks to God; birds, ripe grain, abundant colour; golden hour; joyous.
scenes.weapons_of_warfare: A quiet figure (Paul) with a scroll and a sword of light standing before a towering fortress made of arguments and proud words, its stones loosening and falling harmlessly; captured thoughts shown as small birds gently led to Christ; critics reading his letters nearby; dramatic sky; a spiritual rather than physical battle; no violence.
scenes.fools_speech: Paul being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall of Damascus at night while guards patrol above, a friend lowering the rope; around the edges small vignettes of his sufferings (stormy sea shipwreck, a flooded river, a road at night, a prison) drawn gently and without gore; Paul with a wry humble smile; cinematic night colors.
scenes.thorn_in_the_flesh: Paul kneeling in prayer with open hands, a faint thorn-shaped shadow beside him, three prayers shown as three small flames; above, a glimpse of a luminous layered sky (the third heaven, paradise) glowing with glory he cannot describe; a gentle voice of light, 'my grace is enough'; his posture weak yet peaceful; luminous and tender.
scenes.examine_yourselves: A gathering of Corinth believers examining themselves: a goldsmith's assay in a small fire testing metal, a lamp held up to a mirror, believers greeting one another with a holy kiss on the cheek; above them three lights, grace, love and fellowship, shining as one blessing; Paul writing the last lines of the letter; peaceful, warm, farewell.

galatians.setting: Setting: the churches of Galatia in central Anatolia in the mid-first century AD: a high dusty plateau of wheat fields and shepherds, small towns on Roman roads, rough mountains under a wide sky; also Jerusalem's stone courtyards and Antioch of Syria's table fellowship. Galatian, Greek and Jewish believers together in modest house churches, tunics and cloaks, prayer shawls, a scroll and a reed pen, large handwritten letters. Palette: dusty ochre, wheat gold, mountain blue, clay red; luminous warm light for freedom and the Spirit, sober for conflict; never gory. Cinematic, human and varied.

scenes.paul_to_galatia: Paul at a rough table in the evening writing the last lines of a letter in big letters with his own hand, a scribe and anxious companions beside him, scrolls and an oil lamp, a window opening on the dusty plateau of Galatia at dusk; his face a mix of passion and tenderness; urgent and pastoral.
scenes.another_gospel: A crossroads at the edge of a Galatian village: a smooth messenger in a fine robe preaching to a small crowd of villagers who are half-turning away from the plain road they were on; a second simple traveler quietly pointing to the original path, which glows with light; a tiny bright figure of an angel high in the sky; a sense of a decision; dusty gold, tense but not violent.
scenes.called_by_revelation: Split scene: Paul alone in the Arabian desert at dawn kneeling before a great light on the horizon, rocks and a small campfire, a scroll at his side; and three years later in a Jerusalem house Paul sharing a quiet table with Peter (Cephas) and James, talking intently for fifteen days; contemplative and warm.
scenes.right_hand_fellowship: In a stone courtyard in Jerusalem James, Peter and John give the right hand of fellowship to Paul and Barnabas, with Titus, a young Greek, standing at their side; a few uneasy men watching from a doorway in the shadows; a small purse for the poor placed on a table; solemn, warm and agreeable.
scenes.opposing_peter: At Antioch a long table of mixed Jewish and Gentile believers where Peter is rising and stepping away toward a smaller group of strict men from James at the other side, as Paul stands face to face with him, firm but not hostile; Barnabas torn between them; the Gentile believers left at the table looking hurt; dramatic and human, no violence.
scenes.crucified_with_christ: A figure of Paul standing with open arms and a shadow of a cross behind him, the light of Christ living in his chest; his old self shown as a ghostly outline falling away behind him; the Son of God a tender light who gave himself for him; calm face and a hint of a tear; warm gold against a dark ground; powerful and quiet.
scenes.foolish_galatians: Galatian believers in a village square startled and listening as Paul's letter is read aloud, a large painted board portraying the crucified Christ hanging before their eyes, a man putting down a ritual knife, signs of the Spirit nearby (a gentle flame, a healed man standing); confusion turning to thought; dusty gold light.
scenes.abraham_believed: Abraham looking up at a night sky full of stars, believing; a golden thread of blessing spreading from him out to many nations shown as faces of different peoples below; on the other side a heavy scroll of curse as a weight and a tree with a figure of light on it, the curse carried away; cosmic and tender; deep blue night with gold.
scenes.tutor_to_christ: A stern but kind Greek tutor (paidagogos) with scrolls under his arm leading a young heir by the hand along a road toward a house where a smiling father stands at the door; the child letting go of the tutor's hand at the threshold and running forward; golden evening; warm.
scenes.all_one_in_christ: A great table in a courtyard with believers of every kind: a Jew in a prayer shawl, a Greek in a tunic, a slave in simple dress, a wealthy free man, a man and a woman sitting side by side, all clothed in the same white garment as if clothed with Christ; a unifying golden light; joyous, balanced, symmetrical.
scenes.abba_father: A small child heir running into the open arms of a father at a doorway, with a ring and sandals ready; the Spirit of the Son as a gentle light descending into the child's heart; at his feet a servant's chain left on the ground; sunrise; tender and joyful.
scenes.paul_in_labor: Paul, ill and tired, with a bandaged eye or a weary posture, being received warmly into a Galatian family's home as though he were an angel of God, a woman offering him water and a bed; with a second image of him afterward, pained as a mother in labor, hands pressed to his chest, with small flames growing in the hearts of the believers around him; tender, personal.
scenes.hagar_and_sarah: An allegorical landscape with two hills and two women: Hagar with young Ishmael near a dark desert mountain (Sinai), Sarah with Isaac on a bright hill beneath the gate of a heavenly city above; Abraham between them; a once barren woman rejoicing as children gather; serene and symbolic.
scenes.stand_firm_in_freedom: A man breaking a heavy wooden yoke off his own neck so that it splits, standing firm on a rock with a breeze in his cloak, while some people behind try to hand him a knife and a scroll of rules; in a corner a little yeast swelling a lump of dough; the bright light of liberty; vivid, bold.
scenes.walk_by_the_spirit: Two paths side by side: one a tangle of thorns with figures quarreling, a drunken feast and clenched fists in shadow; the other a luminous path under a tree heavy with nine glowing fruits, a person walking in the Spirit's light, gentle companions beside him; allegorical, warm and clear.
scenes.bear_burdens: Believers carrying one another's burdens: a stumbling man gently lifted by two others, a heavy sack shared among a group; a sower scattering seed in a field where wheat and thorns grow separately; a good harvest seen in the distance; humble, warm, hopeful.
scenes.glory_in_the_cross: Paul's large-lettered scroll lying in the foreground and a plain wooden cross on a hill with the busy world turned away behind it; Paul showing the scars on his back and arm (marks of Jesus) with a calm face, no blood; a new-creation sunrise with rays of peace and mercy; powerful, quiet, luminous.

ephesians.setting: Setting: the Roman world around AD 60: Paul under house arrest in a rented Roman room, chained at the wrist to a guard, dictating to a scribe; the great Greek-Roman city of Ephesus with its marble streets, harbor road and the vast temple of Artemis; Jewish and Gentile believers meeting together in a house church; travelers on Roman roads. Linen and wool tunics, scrolls, oil lamps, sandals, a Roman soldier's armor, a stone wall and cornerstone. Palette: Mediterranean blue, marble white, warm gold; the 'heavenly places' as luminous layered sky; luminous for grace, sober for struggle; never gory. Cinematic, human and varied.

scenes.paul_to_ephesus: Paul in a rented Roman room under house arrest, a light chain at his wrist leading to a calm Roman guard standing by, dictating a letter to a scribe by lamplight; Tychicus waiting with a satchel; a window onto a city street; Paul's face bright and at peace despite chains; scrolls on the table; quiet, dignified.
scenes.blessed_with_every_blessing: A vast luminous sky with layered heavenly places, golden ribbons of blessing pouring down onto a gathered family of diverse believers; threads of light reaching back to a field of stars forming before the foundation of the world; a gentle seal of light on their foreheads and a ring of inheritance; cosmic, warm and joyful.
scenes.prayer_for_enlightened_eyes: A believer with the eyes of the heart opened: rays of light in her eyes, and above, a vision of the risen Christ enthroned on high far above crowned rulers and powers, a river of resurrection power flowing down to the gathered church; Paul praying in the foreground with open hands; luminous, awed.
scenes.made_alive_by_grace: A dim valley of grey sleeping figures, dead in sin, and from above a hand of light raising them to life and seating them in bright heights in Christ; a wrapped gift of grace in the foreground and a potter's vessel newly formed, the saved as God's workmanship; warm, redemptive, quiet.
scenes.one_new_humanity: A high stone wall dividing a Temple courtyard between a Jewish group and a Gentile group being broken down, rubble falling away as the people step through and embrace; above them one new figure of light made from two; a cornerstone glowing and a house and temple rising in the background; joyful and reconciled.
scenes.mystery_of_christ: An ancient sealed scroll opening to reveal a bright mosaic of many nations as fellow heirs; the assembly of ordinary people displaying wisdom while shining heavenly beings watch from above; Paul in chains in the foreground looking up with wonder; vivid and mysterious.
scenes.width_length_height: Paul kneeling in prayer with Christ's light dwelling in a believer's heart, roots and foundations of love deep in rich soil below, and above an immense luminous space: the width, length, height and depth of love drawn as a glowing cosmic dimension reaching beyond measure; a doxology of light at the top; awe.
scenes.unity_of_the_spirit: Seven strands of light (one body, one Spirit, one hope, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God) woven into a single bright cord binding a circle of very different believers who hold hands humbly and gently, a dove-like gentle light above; harmonious and tender.
scenes.gifts_for_building: The ascended Christ above giving gifts as lights descending to people: an apostle with a scroll, a prophet, an evangelist on a road, a shepherd with sheep, a teacher; below them a living building made of many people being fitted together joint by joint, and a child leaving the tossing waves of fads behind; warm, active.
scenes.put_off_old_self: A man taking off a dirty worn cloak (old self) and putting on bright white clothing, a mirror showing a renewed likeness of God; a former thief now working with his hands to give to the needy; two people reconciling as the sun sets; hopeful, ordinary, human.
scenes.walk_in_love_light: A procession of children of light walking at dawn from a dark cave into sunlight, each with a small lamp in hand, sleepers waking and rising; a sweet fragrance of an offering rising above; the light revealing hidden things gently; hopeful.
scenes.be_filled_with_spirit: A joyful house-church gathering singing psalms and hymns together with a harp and a lyre, faces lifted in thankfulness, a gentle golden flame filling the room while a wine cup is pushed aside on the table; warm lamplight and fellowship.
scenes.marriage_christ_church: A husband and wife in a Roman-era home looking at each other with respect, the husband kneeling slightly to wash his wife's feet, with a faint luminous image above of Christ washing and presenting the church as a radiant gathering; gentle, mutual and dignified.
scenes.children_parents_servants: A household in a Roman home: a child listening to a father who kneels to teach rather than scold; a master setting down a threatening posture and treating a servant with respect, both under one Master shown as light overhead; honest and tender; no cruelty depicted.
scenes.armor_of_god: A believer standing firm in the whole armor of God: belt of truth, breastplate of righteousness, shoes of the gospel of peace, shield of faith quenching flaming arrows, helmet of salvation, sword of the Spirit as a glowing flame; shadowy spiritual forces in a stormy sky behind; Paul in chains beside him praying; heroic and calm; no gore.
scenes.tychicus_greeting: Tychicus, a trustworthy traveler with a satchel of sealed scrolls leaving a Roman prison city on a road toward Asia at sunrise, Paul embracing him at a doorway in farewell; companionable, warm and reassuring.
